Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
b152fe95.h: Fell Monstrosity, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

50b0c754.d: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

81e20cfb.d: The active mycelium of mushrooms absorbs the Shroud's magical properties. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?

2001bda3.d:
The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
2001bda3.h: Fell Sporehead, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud

d4e6bcc9.d: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.
d4e6bcc9.h: Fell Critter Queen, First: Revelwood Shroud

d63d3c69.d:
A dense, stone-like carapace torn from the Stalker, a ruthless assassin of the Shroud. Its near-unbreakable structure makes it a crucial material for forging tough and resilient armor.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
d63d3c69.h: Shroud Stalker, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

f3d43b70.d:
Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

They first appear in the Springlands at night, among groups of Fell enemies above the Shroud.

8b8de9ed.d:
A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. 
However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.

0ff44be6.d: The Shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange glowing petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.

d3826a6d.d:
"Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night.

It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.

12831338.d:
A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death.

Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.

7174291b.d: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.

45e22bf5.d: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.

8d8cc80b.d: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!

17aa352c.d: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor!

c911f03e.d: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

50f4361d.d: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!

57fa3bcd.d: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.

2106f5a3.d: Finely ground Aquamarine crystals that sparkle beautifully.

dcb10d80.d: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.

5fa72420.d: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.

7125958d.d: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.

7fe23ed5.d:
An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

It can be found beneath the water in the Veilwater Basin.

d1095cf2.d: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

fc264e7b.d: These capybara bristles can be woven into your clothing to help you glide through the water more easily and prevent you from cooling down too quickly.

3f31d383.d: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

1eaacb52.d: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

a1d54105.d: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the waves don't.

a82a37be.d: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from amphibians that prefer wet or water-filled environments.

7ac3dbac.d: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.

85c69415.d: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

e53b056c.d: It's oozing, unaturally enlarged, and still beating whenever you dare to look away. This heart's potent essence is a key ingredient in crafting resilient armor.
e53b056c.h: Fell Sporeseeker, First: Veilwater Basin Shroud

f7442a68.d: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.

3d29abca.d: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.

1f11576d.d: Vibrant palm leaves that offer ample shade in the blazing sun. They can be used as a crafting ingredient.

5251ac02.d: Sturdy, bendy, and regenerative: Bamboo is an ideal material for any Flameborn looking to build a tropical home.

6b782b38.d: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.

ac5234d9.d: Orange dyed fabric used for clothing.

711b27c8.d: An orange daylily flower. The petals are vibrant enough to be used for dyes.

cfd0af9c.d: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.

d5793269.d: Contains a higher concentration of Shroud compared to Shroud Particles.
d5793269.h: Fell Enemies, First: Veilwater Basin Shroud

32e53ce5.d: The highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus.

8c355569.d: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

237488fa.d: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

5aaf850a.d: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

18e4eb33.d:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

33a8070f.d: Fresh and glistening Drak scales, shimmering and shifting in the golden glow of the sun.

1499eaed.d: The head of a Drak'Dal tribe leader. You've severed it from its neck, but in its place, two new ones will form — figuratively speaking.

f538d98b.d: Fine iron dust, used for different crafting purposes.

36fe559f.d: A collection of conical teeth. The Drak lose them aplenty throughout their lives, and fill the more permanent holes with gold implants or rage.

c2505949.d: Meant to hold and rip prey, these claws are still sharp as ever.

fd3a7c41.d: Violet blood. It runs cold, and the consistency is somewhat syrupy.

707c2f8c.d:
Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge.
All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied viscosity.

ffa225b8.d: A large gland filled with a lethal substance. Handle it with care!

979cd952.d: A dangerous, rotting substance, made half-liquid by its state of decay.
979cd952.h: Fell Vicious Vine, Veilwater Basin Shroud

9cea65f0.d: A sharp, organic stinger. Don't get pricked, or you'll have venom rushing through your veins!
9cea65f0.h: Veilwater Basin Enemies and Cinder's Cradle Crops

4c7cdfd3.d: This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!

cb558c40.d: The Hollow Titan wears no face, only a featureless mask, with his plume swaying slightly with each step.

a22aec37.d: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.

09f2f6d9.d: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.

208998db.d: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.

08d87845.d: Despite its wild mixture, it still looks appealing. It's one of those things that isn't edible, yet you still want to take a bite out of it.

59ccc524.d: A curious blend. Ground, mixed and left to settle. The important thing is that it works. Probably.

eec21da0.d: A massive formation of ectoplasm crystals, pulsing with energy. An enormous life force is trapped within — and has been for a very long time.

10f22301.d: Ground from dense volcanic rock and very rich in minerals.

795a0eba.d: Upon meteorite impact, vast Celestium deposits were born deep within Cinder's Cradle.

ac78b933.d: A bar of refined Celestium. Its surface shifts between deep violet and pale blue.

03ab981c.d: Born from unimaginable heat and weight, diamond endures what would destroy anything else. Every facet tells a different story.

66dec327.d: Ground down but not less sturdy. Every fragment catches light and splits it into cold blues and flickers of gold.

d19987d6.d: No one has ever cut one from rock — only found where the Ancients have passed. Maybe they've brought it to Embervale from wherever they originated.

f312a98d.d: Fine particles that shimmer faintly, leaving a cold blue trace on whatever they settle on.

32555998.d:
Diamond pulled from deep below. Moonstone fallen from somewhere far above. Mother-Of-Pearl drawn from the ocean floor. 
Three materials that would have never met, ground together into something that catches light from every direction at once, warm and cold, and shifting all at the same time.

7f4ab528.d:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

7fa553a8.d: Jagged fragments of dense metal. Too irregular to smelt cleanly, too valuable to discard.

b7dcd57c.d: Pulled from the chest of a fallen construct, it still hums faintly. It's heavier than it looks. Whatever made them move lives inside that.

d7772bb2.d: Perfectly crisp and buttery — a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.

ecf3ed22.d:
A hearty feast that fortifies your body. 

Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

8b394119.d:
This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. 

Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

ed80dfa5.d:
A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. 

After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

4c9d51ba.d: The severed head of a ginormous wolf. It must have belonged to some pack leader.

2fbb2056.d: The head of a Fell Striker. The eyes have been fully absorbed into fungal growth... so they're blinded by more than rage.

9967c4e7.d: It broke your bones with bones. Seemed only fair to take a few of its own. The head's still intact — makes for a decent trophy.

0e0046e5.d: A thick gel that sets harder than it looks. Can be applied as a protective coating over most surfaces. Notably, it also generates heat from within.

9f26c6ad.d: Refined from materials that predate recorded history, this infusion carries properties that resist easy explanation. The Ancient Researcher knows what to do with it.

d3ceb115.d: Heat-hardened scales from a carapace creature of Cinder's Cradle. Blades skate off its surface, and flames find nothing to catch.

f0936271.d: A massive ocular core, torn from Vorgoth, or what was left of him. Inside, faint arcs of energy still flicker.

93a517bf.d: The grand eye that mounted the Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct just moments before now lays in your hands. The fused metal plates and ancient machinery are fascinating.

66dbddcc.d: It looks oddly similar to the Fell Critter Queen, just a different color.

50b1c9bd.d: The Fell Critter Queen Head looks strangely small without the bulk that had once followed behind it.

d1a7babb.d: Her seven glowing red eyes still carry an unsettling weight, but her whip is gone, her power stripped away. You can take her head without worry now.

73adef1d.d: Certain protection demands something personal. Use this bound essence to craft Vorgoth's Armor.

f0d6035b.d: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.

d72f06a3.d: Potent in small doses. A staple ingredient for poison-based concoctions.

463e010f.n: Raw Meat and Azure Russula Skewer
463e010f.d:
This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. 

Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

b4b1e392.n: Raw Meat and Forest Beet Skewer
b4b1e392.d:
A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. 

After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

9ccc0bf1.d:
A hearty feast that fortifies your body. 

Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

8a2c2491.d: You hold it in your hand — the Elixir still dripping from its fanged mouth. It's finally over.

60d6fcc0.d: The severed head of the Scavenger Artificer. Without its harpoon or turret you have nothing to worry about.

46783e00.d: Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.

80ba9c8b.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

5fd360a9.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

a6fe0d97.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

eb21c0e3.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

132687e1.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

64ba825d.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

32233f92.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

49eaae4d.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

3eec9aee.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

c4a0e8f9.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

8d9ad8d8.d: Mei-Yin Chen is a Lunar New Year trader offering seasonal wares. She also sells copies of cosmetic clothing items.

a002b7a8.d: Captain Melville Fontane is a fisher and entrepreneur who offers fishing gear.

65ed8fbc.d: Loraine Crim is an Ancient researcher and adventure enthusiast.

4616bd99.d:
This cat is as dark as the midnight sky and its charming demands for attention never go unanswered. It purrs loudly whenever you are near! 

The Scavengers that kept this cat were unsure whether to call it "Captain" or "Whiskers".

a787938e.d: A loud, energetic dog with sunny fur that yearns for connection. Its tail hasn't stopped wagging ever since you freed it from its cage. The Scavengers that owned this dog previously called it "Ruffles".

1ffac51a.d:
A timid little fellow with spotted fur. It was found in an empty Kindlewastes home. 

The woman that lived in the house before had many dogs, and her favorite was called "Pompom". Maybe this dog is one of its descendants!

cfadb30a.d:
A happy and carefree dog that likes to sleep in. It loves belly rubs and madly dashing in your general direction every time it sees you. 

You found this dog in a tower ruled by Hollow hounds, and a Hollow Warlock. The Warlock seemingly tried to create a vessel for a companion named "Ikko". You interrupted their ritual — but the name stuck.

f86045be.d: This striped cat is a fearsome hunter, always on the prowl. It's quiet, graceful, independent — and proud to present its spoils of war to you after a successful hunt! After a long day of adventuring though, it loves nothing more than to snuggle and sleep.

54868769.d: Despite its angelic looks, this sugary sweet cinnamon-colored cat is a gleeful little rascal who likes getting into trouble! You can never be too mad, though. Just look at those beautiful, sapphire blue eyes!

e011f905.d: This animal can supply you with fresh milk.

5bea4db1.d: A Flightless Redtail with colorful feathers and a strong, regal beak. You can keep it in captivity indefinitely for eggs, and it can't even fly away.

ca2b2dfd.d: A curious, but shy Hophare. Their timid nature and quick reflexes protect them from predators!

473f7cb8.d: An adult Fae Deer. It loves head pats!

50bbc1b7.d: This species constantly regenerates its outer shell, allowing for the collection of scales.

d5c34daa.d: This woolly fellow grows a thick coat to weather the harsh climate of Albaneve Summits. It can be shaved for wool.

9b09f53a.d: A mature Frizzy Goat that can provide milk.

fb867a98.d: A fully grown Round-Billed Sailer, willing to donate fresh feathers for your cause.

41242027.d: An adorable Capybara. It's entirely unbothered while in your arms. The bristles can be used in crafting.

bc451fe0.d: A baby Fae Deer. They are fragile after birth, but they learn to walk and gallop astonishingly quickly!

17b771e6.d: A cute baby Common Goat. They tend to rub their heads against your leg for attention.

57ccffc0.d: This baby Dune Armadillo is already starting to form its horn, later used for digging tunnels — never when you're looking, though. It's strange how that works.

a7e9c2b5.d: A baby Yak, fluffy and warm.

ee916a01.d: A small, round Flightless Redtail baby. Even at this age, their beak can cause some damage. Don't get pecked!

08775890.d: An adorable little Hophare. Its eyes frantically scan the environment when you pick it up, but it calms down quickly.

b539d5af.d: An adorable little Frizzy Goat. Its hair gets easily tangled, but it doesn't seem to mind.

ff7adb58.d: A young Round-Billed Sailer, unable to fly yet due to its overly round shape and tiny wings.

727a19e5.d: A tiny Capybara. It enjoys headpats, chewing on daylilies, soaking in hot springs, and being held tightly in your warm arms.

f72a4c04.d: The Alchemist Balthazar brews potions and other concoctions.

3bddd3a9.d: The Farmer Emily Fray crafts food and helps you grow your plants.

419af480.d: The adventuring Bard, Valory, carves instruments and shares exciting tales from her travels through Embervale.

44836d45.d: The Carpenter Cade Hawthorn can craft anything with wood.

2ee18a0f.d: The Blacksmith Oswald Anders crafts and upgrades armors and weapons.

4fe25661.d: The Hunter Athalan Skree helps you to build armors and creates equipment for survival.

e05f1fdf.d: The Collector, Alden Crowley, can create mystical and dark furniture sets and food items infused with a special, revitalizing energy.

834e9968.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

171d1f69.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

8370590e.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

48133085.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

ede9f3bc.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

ddced9a8.d: The Barber, Elio Ricci, allows you to change your appearance.

10ac553c.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

ebb593f7.d: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

2950da8d.d:
Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly  erecting various structures around your home.

Can only be used within the range of a Flame Altar.

234392d9.d: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

be8b0750.d:
A magical tool capable of adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. 

It can only be used within Flame Altar range and requires overgrowth material.

c3dd790f.d:
A magical tool capable of adding and removing signs of decay to walls in your base. 

It can only be used within Flame Altar range.

8501d2a1.d: An Ancient tool that allows the user to wire up buttons, doors, traps, and more to make them interactable and logically interconnected.

daea0f6c.d:
A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing broken-looking edges to walls in your base. 

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

bb768ef6.d:
A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. 

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

57855b62.d:
A magical tool powered by the Flame. It enables you to fly while building various structures for your base.

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

ebb93c94.d: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

ce5cd929.d: A decorative element that creates an explosive atmosphere, indeed.

faa090e6.d: The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.

eaa04c56.d:
Good omens fell to ash. Lights turned to lies, not promises. What was once a sign of good fortune has been snuffed out by a brush with fate. Pikemead's glory is restored.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

aa28fc75.d: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!

91194cea.d:
Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Iron Trophy.

4d0c55d5.d:
Even when dead, the swirling chaos inside the gaping maw leaves people spellbound. Don't get too close.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

1b5ba878.d:
When encased in solid bronze, the head looks even more menacing than before.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

04b30778.d: The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

f043558c.d:
Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. Its lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

992aa216.d:
Every thundering roar is a spectacle, a bloody sight to behold. They've sunk their tusks into now-forgotten lands... time to reclaim the kingdom.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

97288292.d:
Battle-hardened and brutish, the beastly Vukah would create their Brawlers through constant clashes. Only the strongest survived.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

c9513210.d: Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

b8754057.d: Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

c98e43dd.d:
The Sicklescythe's tongue froze once struck down, too powerless to cast the final curse stuck in its throat.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

3edde96c.d:
New iron teeth now line its disturbing grin. 

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

7084a0c6.d:
The scales are heavy with muck and grime, dulling its glow. Hard to believe such a being once illuminated the water lilies under Pikemead's glorious rule.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

845beb4c.d:
Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

b10f88c4.d: It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.

fc091244.d: Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter — of sanity and sanctum.

f977d7dd.d:
Even the most gruesome creatures must bend to the Flame, no matter their size. At least the slushing sounds inside its dome have subsided.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

831089b6.d:
No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

d49b041a.d:
The inside of the helmet is strangely damp. There's sticky residue everywhere.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Bronze Trophy.

b2357913.d: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

905ed2f4.d:
The prized head of a cyclops, preserved in metal and made accessible to the common person. People can now gaze into its eye unafraid.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

7a4f96be.d:
A mesmerizing display of overwhelming power, and little intelligence.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

c7fac237.d:
Ages ago, they were many — soaring across snowy peaks and through painterly valleys. Now, there is only one. Oh, how far you fall when flying high.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

403639c0.d: A lonely soul, brought low by the Shroud — and set free by your blade.

34e382d1.d:
The last dragon's head. The final nail in the coffin. The end of an era, and the start of something new.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

8fd0a376.d:
Their faces are frightening, but they mostly just want to herd goats and yaks. People only make up a small portion of their diet. 

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

a9abae56.d: A severed Cyclops Head, still wearing a helmet, although that's hardly needed now.

d44f7de3.d:
Large, in charge, and ready to barge in while you are busy scavenging caves.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

2be4935e.d: A severed Hydrak'Dal Head with a regal headdress. Even now, it still exudes authority and a will to dominate.

26783c50.d:
The Hydrak'Dal would surely be outraged that you covered his golden decorations with bronze. Fortunately, he can no longer complain.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

d2788311.d:
When you stand opposite this face, you remember its screams. "Zzzrrr Krrrraallllll Hrrrrggg" it echoes in your head, only this time you don't have to feel weak in the knees.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

3a03b30b.d:
This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

8860277f.d:
Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

3bb15c50.d:
There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

71412c8c.d:
As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

d4b3d6a1.d:
Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

a807ade3.d:
The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

f3ba29d2.d:
Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

d1bab401.d:
Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

a0b9b47c.d:
Completely gilded, you no longer notice the dirt and stench, so you can hang it in your living room without hesitation.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

3adfc737.d:
The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

c49b5fa4.d:
Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

132cfd5d.d: The bare helmet of the Hollow Titan. At its crown rises a stiff plume.

28be1628.d:
The Bronze Hollow Titan Head carries a warm, dull sheen into your home.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

929bd72b.d:
The plume becomes rigid and jagged, like frozen spikes. You don't have to worry; they won't attack you anymore.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

fa8fd84e.d:
The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

d951b7a9.d: The Direwolf's Head dominates the wall, it's sheer scale dwarfing any common wolf beside it.

26f4b88d.d:
Cast entirely in bronze, every savage detail of the Direwolf has been immortalized in cold metal.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

f1d8bbff.d:
The snarling lips and crushing fangs remind you of the countless fights you had with the Direwolf.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

215ae3dd.d:
The golden Direwolf does not show that it was victorious — it shows that you were.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

d4b130e2.d: When placed, the eye slowly becomes something more than just a core again. Thin layers of skin reform around it, forming a heavy eyelid that never fully closes.

eb0aa6fb.d:
Bronze seeps into the newly formed flesh, binding eyelid and tendrils into a unified shell.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

b5631c7c.d:
The internal glow is dim and struggling against confinement.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

ad15dafb.d:
Gold smooths over the jagged form, giving it an almost sacred appearance. The tendrils resemble ornamental roots rather than organic tissue. This trophy shows you are the greatest Flameborn of all time, because you did not back down from fighting evil more than once. You did it multiple times and were successful.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

313a5086.d: You don't need to worry about a sudden flash of light tearing through the air anymore. That era is gone.

6647d173.d:
The waves of projectiles raining down on you are still a vivid memory. But this eye won't hurt you no more.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

6888b135.d:
In its iron covered form the structure becomes heavier and more rigid, its surface darkened and sealed.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

396041c0.d:
The central eye remains visible, but no longer carries the pressure it once did. It now feels less like a weapon and more like a relic.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

bead6da0.d: Her red glowing head is smaller than your memory suggested and her mandibles less threatening.

13d0d67d.n: Bronze Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
13d0d67d.d:
Even molten bronze poured on top of her head couldn't dull her features. Her body remains a deep crimson, and her eyes glow with the same unsettling red as before.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

6abb247c.n: Iron Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
6abb247c.d:
It's quite unsettling that her intense stare and her burning eyes won't fade. They keep on watching you.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

e5bd8215.n: Gold Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
e5bd8215.d:
Take this golden trophy as a sign of your multiple victories, but also remember: she won't stop staring back, she refuses to be covered, and to be forgotten.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

192315e2.d: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.

4e9956ed.d:
The Fell Critter Queen's Head mounted on a wall and covered in bronze seems more ornamental than threatening.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

544e7d4c.d:
When you now look at the Fell Critter Queen's Head you wouldn't think that she once was powerful enough to command an entire swarm.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

1ddf6ab1.d:
You have slain the Fell Critter Queen so many times that her golden trophy can embellish your walls. One could say you have earned the right to take her place and be the new Queen. But there was nobody left to rule.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

18f1bce0.d: Her whip still haunts you in your dreams so you chose to hang her head instead.

ff0c19e2.d:
Each of her glowing eyes feels like a remnant of one of her whips — echoes of a violence that is no longer there.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

266d9e2a.d:
Her eyes don't move, yet they seem to follow you all the same. It feels less like being watched, more like being measured.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

50de96b0.d:
For a moment, you're back on the battlefield. Her presence brings the same tension into the room, as if the fight never quite ended.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

1af750a7.d: The Scavenger Scattershot used to spin toward you like a storm. Now he just hangs there, still.

acd2364a.d:
Looking at his teeth up close, you're almost grateful he stuck to throwing scrap.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

aef1dbbe.d:
You dreaded the moment he opened his elixir bottle. Without a stomach, it's not going anywhere now.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

0290bd0d.d:
He spun, he threw his scrap balls, and drank his way through every fight he had. But in the end, none of it was enough. This trophy is proof of your victory.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

2ed829a4.d: Thinking back at the fight, you can feel the pull of his harpoon, which you cannot escape. Luckily, now when you don't want to be close to him again, you can just leave the room.

568fb8c3.d:
The Scavenger Artificer builds, and you suffer the consequences. Now you build with his head. How the tables have turned!

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

bef38d7a.d:
The craftsman in you has created a masterpiece. This iron trophy is a true work of art. Perhaps the Scavenger Artificer would be proud, too, if only he could still speak.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

87acfbd8.d:
He reeled you in every time. Not anymore. His head's gilded and mounted, for good.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

e6eb04bc.d: This fight made you stop believing in safe corners. You can be sure that he always closes the gap between you two. Maybe nailed to your walls, he will finally leave you be.

2ac39c82.d:
Standing far away didn't save you in the fight. Now you don't have to worry about the distance between you; you can admire the bronze-glazed head from up close.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

0e7ff5a8.d:
By now you know that running to the back isn't a winning strategy; it's just an invitation for him to get the better of you.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

40683c21.d:
The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

357d43b9.d: You stare at the skull and swear the floor trembles. It doesn't. Yet.

1fa0994e.d:
You checked twice for a pulse, just to make sure it's dead. Skeletons normally don't have one, and this one is covered in bronze... You're probably in the clear.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

803bb301.d:
Some fights leave scars. Others leave a fear of the undead.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

ee3abfaa.d:
At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury — and this trophy is proof of it.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: 

Mae's Memoir:
The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest
The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds
As the sunlight sets in the faraway west
On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms 

Ony's' Memoir:
I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

Orpheus' Memoir:
Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss
Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains
Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss
My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

Polaris' Memoir:
I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky
To find your path, you must look to me only
Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny
Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

8ae2788d.d:
Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

0d10d9ff.d:
A robust, small sea lily fossil. No matter how you turn it, you're always greeted by a tendril or imprint.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

a996a5c5.d:
These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons — together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

6766cae6.d:
Multiple ancient trilobites, perfectly still and preserved in a petrified coat of sediment.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

d5b4aab8.d:
An impressively big ammonite fossil. The remains of this marine cephalopod once housed a large, tentacled, sea-bound creature. In Embervale superstition, every identifiable rim extending from the spiral's core is said to bestow a day of good luck.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

e7fa4cb4.d:
A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

c5e9d43e.d:
A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

f0623823.d:
A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

8ff0888d.d:
This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal. 

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

1ae99daa.d:
A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

a06d792c.d:
A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

eb595e63.d:
The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendants of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

557e471e.d:
A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

e0f07f01.d:
A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers — but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

a8e6a318.d:
Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

8d4a9286.d:
The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers — but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

43405f8f.d: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.

8f2ba3f3.d: This dusty old tome emanates a silent hate, restrained by thick iron shackles. Every fortnight, whenever this book is near, a spirited chain rattle fills the midnight air, and the pages inside convulse. It's as if something was trying to leap off the parchment to turn from ink to flesh and blood.

b0d6e390.d: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...

A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.

2788af7a.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

c13e1bb6.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients.

The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.

cc1dfefb.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.

17b13b72.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon— a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.

ef45605f.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.

adfee281.d:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.

06caabdd.d:

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

199511da.d:

f6c0f923.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Long ago, a wanderer brought an enthralling gift to the people of Embervale."

I so wonder what sort of day it was — I chose to paint the sky as overcast; but whether the air was joyous or heavy, I could not know... - J

920d7897.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"The Elixir. It was a cure, a blessing, a weapon."

His frame nearly subsumes the Elixir. They bleed into each other; one dark shape against the sky... He was both peddler and prophet — but what for? - J

cc18b776.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Once concealed by the Ancients, its might had been set free."

This one's for you, Brother. I wonder... did the Wanderer speak these same words when he handed you your favorite toy? I imagine you leaning back, almost lounging in that throne like you used to. I miss that side of you. - J

b19bf39e.n: Above The Vermin, The Cowards, The Liars
b19bf39e.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"With it came power, mistrust, and a longing for more."

"Levitation", you said. I could not believe my ears, but you were never one to jest, so I took you at your word. What did it feel like? Was it bright and sharp? Weightless and warm? Suffocating and unsteady? Maybe a little bit of everything. - J

dae1d729.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Humanity dug the Elixir Wells, ripping apart the land and each other to quench their thirst."

When you told me of your family's pain, it reminded me of that of my own people. We're so quick to tear each other to shreds, aren't we? Some will fight for scraps and die with nothing. I wish you the best. -J

90939401.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Elixir and blood, a drop for a drop."

You did not hear me when last we spoke. Maybe imagery will reach you, Manny. Sorry. I know you hate it when I call you that. - J

02e95a44.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"But from the depths of the Wells an unforeseen curse swept into Embervale."

A horrible nightmare of mine. I could not rest until I had put it to canvas... but now, I can't stand to look at it. -J

ffa43ea5.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"The Shroud, a ruinous fog which sought only to spread and devour."

It's a terrifying sight... but packed tightly against the light of the morning sun. I wanted to show that there is still hope... somewhere out there. - J

c68b4ced.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Facing their downfall, Ancients and humans united to forge the Flameborn."

It was difficult to capture the likeness of my Ancient companions... and my own, too, no less! My hair has gotten so long. I did not even realize until I brought it on canvas! - J

5da52fad.d:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"A flaming soul in a mortal body, nurtured amongst the ashes of a dying world.
Now, your time has come. Awake!"

My final piece: The last spark, the hearth of hope, the beginning of a new era. I wanted to paint the Flameborn directly, but I cannot begin to fathom what they will look like. Maybe I will get to meet them one day... then, I'll paint them a proper portrait! Until then, I hope you keep this painting safe, friends. - J

Yet, their caution spells weakness, and their words drip with envy... They would wield it if they could. Why shouldn't you?

This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

e556e9dd.d: A sharpened broadsword. Swinging it comfortably requires strong arms.

a461a4c3.d: A basic short sword designed for fights in narrow areas. Remarkably agile with a sharp tip.

b45d5d42.d: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.

8e40910a.d: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone, or to pierce traitors’ backs.

c5388da5.d: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Marksman Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.

5856c5ff.d: Pierce Enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Scout Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.

fb62cceb.d: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword — shrunken for your convenience.

57e67982.d: Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.

032d9171.d: A cleaver coated with acid and bile, swung by Scavenger Butchers. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.

277c6671.d: A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell soldiers and commanders.

2ef1d071.d: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.

add45108.d: The weapon of choice for Lord Vorgoth's personal guard. Blue lines follow the blade's body, carving around its peaks and valleys like the north winds.

fb2ab2c2.d:
A battered metal shield that allows you to block and parry physical attacks. Young squires tend to place all their hope in these... until the metal starts to bend and give.

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

ed560164.d: A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up through many crusades.

e2d67728.d: A shield that unites the entire brute force of the North behind it. It opposes the Ancients and any fools who dare not to make way.

944b92bd.d: A blade commonly used by the Striker commando of the Fell. It's brutal, jagged, and efficient.

2bd0e75b.d: A bow wielded by the army's elite archers. No intruder dares to cross the sights of a Sentinel.

7a6c4639.d:

According to folklore, this symbolizes the origin of the drakian Broodmother Vesztah.

9caf00b9.d: The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.

649beaa9.d: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.

"It's not right to leave humanity behind. Their world is ours. I feel, no, I know that this is my home. Stars be damned — Let's fight for Embervale!"

- Ezramin

"Embervale is nothing but a speck of dust; a single point in time from which we will propel ourselves forward. We'll leap from here, into the future — towards the stars above. Towards home. No matter where we land... we will make our mark. They will remember us. They will remember me."

- Manathor

With this, we'll nurture the flora of the future while defending the present! 1551050d.d: These lightweight gloves are perfect for holding a quill and signing decrees.

bd87d2e3.d: A long, flowing garment. The lower seam effortlessly hovers around the ankles while you walk.

c03369e5.d: These sleek trousers are usually worn underneath more lavish dresses or tunics.

9120ab8a.d: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.

eb54e797.d: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.

8d962cc2.d: Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

7f9039d3.d: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

f6ce4ae0.d: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

2b24b745.d: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

da64e033.d: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

fd9bd180.d: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.

beefbcb2.d: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

10ef81f1.d: Stomp out anti-feudalist uprisings in style with these fashionable and finely crafted shoes!

75369f67.d: Billowy pants that were made from the finest silks. They create an interesting and lavish silhouette.

c7e407b5.d: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

48eb0567.d: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.

3158f848.d: A merchant's hat that will draw attention in the market square when paired with A LOUD ENOUGH VOICE and good deals!

b80501af.d: A gleeful and jingly hat. The little bells make frolicking around more joyous.

8ba17ca5.d: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.

3b8f9f33.d: A distinguished hat with a folded-up brim. The front has been embellished with a small metal detail.

774c9e44.d: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

2226757b.d: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

de99ab1f.d: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

a3d313d1.d: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

78d318c6.d: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

05f0f864.d: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

e3772144.d: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.

1b0b9a93.d: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

92b5cee2.d: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

0e4a7206.d: A dark tunic held together by "fake" bones. They rattle like real ones do. How suspicious!

626aaa5e.d: These dark gloves are ideal for going trick or treating!

fec4f68d.d: You'll make people shake in their boots when you approach in these spooky shoes!

6f9c6d81.d: A shadowy hood that hides a sinister skull mask underneath. Scary!

4be793b3.d: The ruby-red cloth, emerald-colored scales, and golden trim create a warm and regal cosmetic armor piece when combined.

b9c15fba.d: The sharp edges of these gloves that stretch towards the wearer's fingertips jot out like viper fangs.

d9935f53.d: These boots have an intricate scale pattern on their green plating.

a55fd19f.d: A pair of grey trousers. They layer well under the more elaborate cloth of the upper body armor.

43041835.d: This helmet lets you portray a particularly patient and calculating gaze.

19b9626a.d: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

e44374c7.d: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!

a54f3e1d.d: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

fe75578e.d: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

a51081c0.d: A floppy hat with red feathers.

13de860b.d: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.

58191924.d: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.

4c52be82.d: With these boots, the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.

80d8872e.d: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".

e3c8870e.d: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.

f39b17c5.n: Scholar of the Young Flame Cloak
f39b17c5.d: A resplendent white-and-gold cloak interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it symbolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.

f593cf73.n: Scholar of the Young Flame Gloves
f593cf73.d: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.

c3f3b180.n: Scholar of the Young Flame Boots
c3f3b180.d: These golden boots carried the "Scholars of the Young Flame" across the open roads of Embervale. The soles still carry dust from places you have yet to discover.

43ce7009.n: Scholar of the Young Flame Pants
43ce7009.d: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.

c716b5bd.n: Scholar of the Young Flame Helmet
c716b5bd.d: A radiant headpiece that can be spotted from afar. Not only when the burning sun reflects off of it.

e703cee8.d: A breezy tunic that's perfect for a day by the shore.

f50a003c.d: These simple, comfortable boots are perfect for taking a stroll on a warm summer's day.

0ddd3987.d: A pair of lightweight pants. They're simple and easily replaced, so it's not too bad if they become bleached by the sun or drenched with water.

acd1bbdf.d: This impressive coat is regal, lived-in, and vaguely... salty. It makes you feel as though you should be steering a ship to safety amidst a thundering storm!

6a5b0ce2.d: A sporty headband with gold accents. It matches the set's belt and makes you feel like the ruler of the Summer Games!

3f6d75d3.d: Asymmetrical bangles that aid viewers in visually differentiating your arm movements as you dash past them towards the finish line.

d51fb2c2.d: The brown trousers possess a reinforced and padded knee area, visible through the applied scale pattern.

2bc19ce3.d: A bandage wrap that lets your takeoff foot achieve maximum jump power. These light coverings make it easier to protect your soles from harm as you prepare to propel yourself through the air!

9772be61.d: An athletic-looking top made from vibrant fabric, held together by leather straps. The cropped cut lets you show off your physique!

6204ef1f.d: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!

f4163e2b.d: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.

6cf3594c.d: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.

1a2b0d76.d: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.

9a9bc130.d: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.

b0576904.d: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

2747f320.d: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such are both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.

a2b8a839.d: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.

17798141.d: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.

f3fb4be8.d: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.

1fc4f8e1.d: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow, metal trim, and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.

a7662f4f.d: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.

8abf5adc.d: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.

301394f5.d: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

d7be4a32.d: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

f99248fb.d: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.

1b6f8259.d: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

42efc84b.d: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.

574b419c.d:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

860e1804.d: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

d8b6d3f5.d: A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun — and the beginning of a new era of progress.

ec265cdb.d: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.

7ebd7ff3.d: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

1564f056.d: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

241a667e.d: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

16078861.d: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

c476a445.d: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

f9a905d7.d: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.

ef7d3de6.d: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

8664f5f9.d: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

53681ca1.d: This robe was fashioned to look like Emperor Moth wings. The double fur collar is especially soft. Below it lies a macrame shirt, expertly woven by nimble hands.

62c412e1.d: Thick wooly gloves. They vaguely smell of bonfires and animal fur. Perhaps someone was wearing these while petting their furry companions by a fire?

14e566fd.d: Comfortable brown boots that make you feel as if you're being carried on a moth's wings.

e27d3fbd.d: Furry boots wrapped with cords. The strands can be unwound to fasten makeshift bandages in a pinch. Decorative pom poms hang dangle from the sides.

d6878b34.d: A hood with a striking pair of plumose antennae. It keeps you warm and safe while wandering at night, and perhaps the antennae will help you find what you desire — or what you really need.

68f1ac9a.d: Just enough to protect the wearer from sparks.

c52f14b3.d: A simple head-covering to soak up some of that pesky sweat. Keeps your precious ears away from hot swinging irons!

860b4858.d: These boots will still keep their shape even if you drop a hammer on them. Or tongs. Or an entire anvil. How handy!

37f161e3.d: These pants are smeared with soot.

a1f78eb8.d: Soft and comfortable maid attire. It's easily cleaned if dirtied with washing water, milk, or wine.

bda863e7.d: A headwrap that's white as snow.

fea32e48.d: This armor provides perfect protection when venturing out into the forest.

2de07d35.d: A yellow headband that keeps your hair out of your face when hunting or lumbering.

7522e16f.d: Makes your step silent and swift.

3f29b78a.d: These belted pants will create a perfect fit no matter if you've had venison or porridge for dinner.

dd66c03b.d: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

08c6ef4a.d: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.

ba301c41.d: It keeps the sun out of your tired eyes. That's all it has to do!

bcfeae9d.d: Sunbleached pants, carefully patched and sown with leftover thread. The cloth is wearing thin in some areas...

811d08d3.d: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

577c8c58.d: People don't make eye contact with gravediggers because it brings bad luck. Therefore, some graveyard keepers wear a cap that covers their eyes to avoid trouble.

135989f7.d: There's some extra space in the pockets perfect for storing crypt keys, "borrowed" rings, and lost fingerbones.

46fbf837.d: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

1761dd57.d: Perfect for wading through ash and moldy earth.

e55ac05d.d: A grassy green dress for housekeeping or working on the farm.

c0b1da4b.d: A milky white headwrap that keeps your hair out of your face while working.

2ee5a429.d: Simple shoes with flat heels that pair well with dark stockings.

bfbb706e.d: A hat that is made both practical and fun with added fluffy fur.

32bbf3a2.d: A heavy tunic with fur lining.

594fe1c2.d: Sturdy boots for gathering wood. They're lined with fur, ideal for the summits.

560ba1e2.d: Worn-out gloves with sun spots and a fur trim.

41da0d72.d: A long furry coat, often worn by the citizens of the Albaneve Summits. It's very cozy.

f0ee743f.d: A classic pair of gloves. Don't they make you want to throw a snowball?

97eab852.d: A pair of comfortable boots perfect for snow days.

732839c3.d: A pair of pants with fleece on the inside.

a66c1a7e.d: A hat that looks like it protects your precious ears from the cold. It's just cosmetic, though.

5bc2f315.d: Loraine always liked to safekeep the bones she found on excavations personally, as they were too precious to entrust to anyone else.

8b8fdd6b.d: These glasses have seen countless horizons, failures, and successes. You think you can see some faint scratch marks on them — were they caused by vultures?

ba08f81d.d: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

20496878.d: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.

4ba1d245.d: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow, metal trim, and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.

26324e2c.d: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.

5cb01a35.d: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

f11c2892.d: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

120a3922.d: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

23374069.d: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

2cbc2925.d: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.

52328797.d: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

ecd5eaab.d: A floppy hat with red feathers.

54f976a5.d: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!

92b0b7e9.d: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

1b560e9d.d: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

d98c7d04.d: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

e8ff99a8.d: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.

1fa0497d.d: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.

5121541a.d: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.

c7fc7752.d: With these boots, the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.

96770fa0.d: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".

46083b8f.d: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.

942b5b22.d: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!

766dd5bf.d: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.

632d8e9b.d: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.

58978b25.d: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.

681d54b4.d: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.

fceb3b15.d: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such are both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.

ba540e76.d: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

8e501903.d: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.

8be44ae4.d: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.

abcbc419.d: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.

ebbd5b70.d: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

6913f415.d: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.

a9c7314b.d:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

8780dfaa.d: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

a80f753f.d: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.

00c51aa4.d: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

d75093a8.d: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

2dd49c5e.d: A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun — and the beginning of a new era of progress.

a59c113e.d: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

e2f3b101.d: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

572a4793.d: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

07bc01fc.d: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

e816d088.d: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

842471bf.d: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

01e879a5.d: A rising phoenix thrones above this helmet, protecting your steadfast gaze under its wings. It's a stern reminder of your destiny and the eternity it bears.

20a5e804.d: Scarlet gloves that remind you of all the blood you've shed. Will the battle ever end? You do not know for sure, but today, we shall not dwell on it — for today is for the living.

4d3ad296.d: A golden parade armor that shines brighter than the sun. A resilient flame flickers inside the chestplate's cavity, framed by the sigil which the Flameborn have claimed as their own.

da771a05.d: Gilded boots adorned with fiery, red gemstones. The pattern above the shins bears a resemblance to rays of sunlight or the glory of the blazing Flame.

07d48488.d: Comfortable pants fashioned from crimson cloth. Being both durable and imposing, they can be worn for parades as well as war.

8f03834b.d: Magic frames everything you do. Whatever you witness, you see through the lens of the spark — a light that lingers just outside your vision, always peering in from the edges. You serve the Flame. Do so with elegance.

b9c17c05.d: A pair of gloves that enable you to synchronise syllables to spells and weave warding sigils into bulwarks gracefully.

9023e2a3.d: A lightweight, yet sturdy garnet-colored gambeson. The fire of magic burns inside. It is your duty, Flameborn, to tend to it evermore — for if you perish, the art of sorcery will die with you.

d890f07e.d: Tightly fitted boots, made from gold metal and cured leather. With these, you will be able to dance between the rain of bolts and blades, casting doom upon your foes with swift movements.

5fb1a78f.d: Lilly-white pants peek through from beneath the crimson coat. It makes you wonder: Can there be innocence in times of war? Despite the bloodshed, the hearts of those who wield magic must always remain pure. Otherwise, their power becomes unbound from both law and morals.

f70481f6.d: A hood and mask. The latter reminds you of a bird of prey, ready to descend on its enemies at high noon. Your shadow will be the last they'll ever see.

eb6df346.d: Find the foe's weakness, then aim, breathe, and shoot. Nothing can escape your arrows when the Flame lights their path.

9f98866f.d: It's a chestplate that has a short, red cape attached to the back. A Flame marks the centre of it, resting where the heart should be. Everything you do, and all you feel, is forever bound to the light of the fire. Let it fill you with pride and warmth.

2b28d8c9.d: A magnificent golden shell for your feet to slip into. With these, you can march with pride — down the streets of your kingdom, through the darkened forest, or into the heart of the Shroud.

0cfe891a.d: A pair of pants that fills you with a deep sense of duty despite their simplicity.
