I'd be most interested in shaping the 4th generation of models... but I must not get ahead of myself! For now, it's best I continue my journey to the Worker's Ward. I hear there is another site nearby that requires a routine check-up.

- Artificer Constantio

My ascent was successful, though I must admit our newly rifted environs have greatly hindered me on the journey. No matter — I deem this site adequate for storing and preparing the constructs designated to work at the nearby ward. 
The local tower is a pleasant architectural addition that can double as a safe for valuables, should an alarm arise.

Furthermore, I've progressed on my research with the construct suit. The skewed proportions really do appear charming to me. Humans are just so compact, aren't they? 
For an alpha version, it will most definitely suffice. Perhaps the construct hub at Manathor's Plaza will provide me with even more inspiration. I'm slated to head there next.

- Artificer Constantio

The terminal is in perfect condition. Elevators, lights, and recharge stations all seem in order.

Constructs are maintained in the basement, where repairs and security details are handled. Once ready, they're deployed to the middle floor via lift. The lift continues upward, capable of carrying controller personnel to the command center above.

Everything is clean and tidy. I suppose the landfill — or gaping abyss — below the basement is used frequently to declutter. 
My plan was to stay longer and retrieve some materials for my construct suit, but my time here has been cut short. The Mother Flame calls upon all Ancients to gather in the citadel.
I reckon that this is due to the encroaching Shroud... but I cannot be certain.

No matter what, I will ensure to pass through the Proto Vessel Bay on my path. The future — our future — must be preserved!

- Artificer Constantio

We have to abandon all our efforts.
Every construct. Every spire. Every proto vessel. Yes, even my own creations.

A new arrival was due this solstice. The proto vessels were ready. We were ready. It is a pity. No, it is shameful. I always enjoyed welcoming a young Ancient. A new face, an old soul... sometimes, I thought I could see those that came before inside their spark. Remnants of previous lives, like leftover mechanisms from retired construct models.

Our numbers may grow no further. Perhaps we are doomed to be diminished after all. I cannot bend the solstice, nor the Shroud — but I can store whatever I have for those who follow after me. 
I've hidden the final piece of my construct suit in this room, behind a loose stone in the walls of a nook. Perhaps it will aid you, whoever you are. And then, maybe, there will still be hope for us.

- Artificer Constantio

There was once a mermaid
Below the mirror of the moon
In crystal puddles, she'd wait
'Fore hunger'd wake her soon

Something gnawed at her inside
The thirst, a thrill to seek
A sanguine flush lit up her eyes
She sought something to eat.

Floral scent on her skin
Smile rosé like wine
She'd draw someone in
A partner to dine 

They thought her heart pure
Saw the sparkle in her gaze
Had fallen for her lure
Suffocation, sweet embrace

So the water's red, gushing
For her dance inspires
The moon to start blushing
From the blood of admirers

I loathe abandoning this project before completion, but the elders are right. Gems simply do not possess enough energy to power our ascent.

Still, I may return to my forge blueprints eventually... so I've stored my notes away on the upper floor.

It seems the lock mechanism is working as intended. Being able  to see the door and the light above it from the button below is really quite practical!

p.n: Gem Forges: Construction Notes, Generation VII
p.t:
Primary Materials:
Effusion Rock: High silicon content required. Preferred substrate: Basalt (for adequate thermal stability)
Precious Metal Conduit: Aurum alloy recommended. (superior conductivity and resistance to arcane deterioration.)

Inner Fibre Hull: Candidate materials under review:
Celestium:  Increases structural integrity and energy retention.
Moonstone: Too brittle for compression. However, adularescence may improve internal light propagation. Further testing required.

Conductor Assembly:
Use diamond lattices for maximum durability and better resistance to internal fractures.

Foundation Base:
Construct a wide circular base to ensure uniform pressure distribution across forge chamber flooring. 

Compression:
Reinforce overhead supports to prevent structural distortion.

Final Reminder:
Increase storage capacity for Archaic Essences. Insufficient containment may result in uncontrolled combustion.

Long ago, we lost a piece of our star.
It ripped through the void, a bright streak against the dark, fleeing our sight. A flash from something to nothing... the light of ghosts, the memory of home.
The spectre turned scout; for it crashed into a planet most promising. It formed the heart in Embervale's midst — Illuminating a hollow in which rainwater pooled, and life began to bloom.

A fascinating first. A kaleidoscope of potential.
We had to see it for ourselves.

Stoic and stalwart as they were, the twin mountains allowed our entry. We sampled, scored, and savored all we could before turning our gaze back to the firmament... when the guards of creation denied our leave, barring the gate inside the crimson core. We pleaded and begged.
It was not enough.

Fire, fire, burning pyre. We scorched a hole into the sky. The mess we made let the moonlight reach low; reach us — chaining the sea of stars inside a marble that hung above like a taunt. 
One could imagine their palms outstretched, clasping around something that cannot, will not be touched. It was out of reach.
It was not enough.

Our gaze turned inward. Downward. Searching for a source beyond Flame and Spark inside the core. That's where we found it. Another subject to prod.
The rotting fruit with a thousand seeds, asleep, yet breathing — then rousing, reeling, reaching.
We left it buried, sealed beneath words of warning and layers of grime.

We were not enough.

I declare that my work on your new alarm system is hereby concluded. I consider Violet V2 a notable improvement over the previous iteration! Please find the key data concerning the functionality below.

Most established features were kept: When an intruder is spotted, code violet is triggered, and the facility will lock down. As before, the system is connected to the pressure plates embedded in the floor. Should they detect unauthorized personnel, they will sound the alarm.

Additionally, however, we've been granted a set of Signal and Intrusion Reveal Nodes (S.I.R.N.), courtesy of Constantio. These surveillance constructs will alert the system to intruders, should they be spotted in their vicinity. This will awaken the guard units.

Of course, you may recall the last "false" alarm we suffered... alongside the S.P.D.R. malfunction. Sneaking past security gone rogue in an effort not to perish is tedious, isn't it? Well, you're in luck! With Violet V2, I've implemented a fail-safe: A button inside the control room that can turn off the alarm.

Should questions or complications arise, feel free to contact me.

p.n: Operational Report: Energy Output and Water Quality Assessment
p.t:
Following the integration of the fourth water wheel, energy output has increased in line with projected performance expectations. However, the improvements may not suffice to meet operational targets.

I am slowly but surely coming to the conclusion that our efforts here may be in vain after all. Furthermore, recent water quality samples have raised concern. 

We've charted significantly elevated levels of suspended solids. No microscopes were involved in these initial findings — Anyone who isn't entirely blind could tell with a simple visual inspection.

The sample has been submitted for laboratory analysis.

As an interim measure, I plan to install a temporary filtration system to reduce the potential impact on operations. Long-term planning remains pending until the laboratory results reveal the composition of the sample.

Eldermere
Chief Engineer, 503 D.A.

Regretfully, it appears that my genius remains misunderstood.

My creation is clearly superior in a multitude of ways. It can jump-start machinery in the blink of an eye, marking a perceivable improvement over any other currently known initiation procedure! Additionally, its precision and ability to concentrate electricity are unprecedented.

The others don't seem able to follow my logic. Perhaps I should've made myself clearer to them... They claim this wand is not handy; that the trigger does not lie well in the hand — they simply cannot be serious. The tool is perfectly shaped for its intended purpose, and there is no need for it to "feel" appropriate during handling. 

I see that I ought to explain the concept of telekinesis once more.

Nevertheless, I suppose I'll store it in the hallways for now. A tool that remains unused is an utter waste of space. 

Eldermere
Chief Engineer

Good news: I managed to stow away the vessels after all. Finished right on time for the solstice — We're prepped. Told you not to doubt me, didn't I? 
You were right about the climate, though. It's downright awful — but perfect for conservation, I suppose. I've wrapped myself in layers for every shift, and suggest you do the same. 

The cold isn't the only thing giving me shivers. Did you see the guard construct? Forgot what they call it... Creepy thing. Why so many legs...?
At least it'll keep the Proto Vessels safe during Code Violet... Engineers said something about this being "V1", meaning some doors will shut permanently once the alarm is raised. It'll be a hassle to complete repairs in the chamber like that, so watch out and don't get locked in! 
If you do, well, I hope you brought warm garb.

See you after my vacation!

I thought of my old beliefs as a coat I could shed.
Now, I realize they've tainted me in a way that was so far beyond my comprehension. They've seeped into my body, lingering just beneath the skin.

When I began my journey here, I did so with the best intentions. To better understand the Ancients. To learn and to grow.
And still,  I came with weaponry. Swords, bows, daggers — I wanted to be prepared. Prepared for anything. For battle.

That's why I gripped my wand tightly when I saw the Ancient in the distance. It was the first time that I ever laid eyes on one of their kind. They rose from a grassy patch in the valley, suddenly tall against the setting sun. Then, the arched back down. 
They were sampling thyme. And humming.

I felt shame wash over me as I loosened my grip. My instincts had betrayed me yet again. So for a time, I just stood there. Listening to a melody that sounded familiar, as if it were human... and maybe it was. Perhaps even more so than I.

From now on, I'll continue without my weapons, without fear, and with a new tune on my lips to march to. Some notes come out crooked; others choke me still... Yet, it's not the song that plagues me, but the horrid cough that rattles below. 

Darya

lore.c: The Shroud, Elixir, and Elixir Wells

p.t:
Our onslaught on the Ancient gate was met with little resistance. Thus, its stone was promptly crushed to dust beneath the march of my men.

The Ancients are trying to lull me... they've sapped energy from their barriers to fuel the cloistered weapon in their midsts! This is a declaration of war — so war they shall get!

I can see their fabled Citadel in the distance... proudly crossing the horizon's line; ripping through the waxing moon's light!
This is where they keep their flame, so my wandering friend says... where they will summon fire to rain down on MY people, scorching the earth of MY lands!

The reign of rats must end...Together, we must tear them down.
Down the gullet. Down the spiral. 
Down, down, down 
to us.

— Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard

Two heartbeats rattle my ribcage.

One clings to a vengeful rhythm. It expands, rips and tears, suffocates me from within. It feels righteous, though vindictive.

There is another tone that reverberates inside. A quiet hum, mild with remembrance of... of what, exactly? Some spectre of myself I do not recognize; less wizened and haggard.

He speaks of a border that can only be ruled by a strong hand. Of a proud but shattered kingdom, wishing to unite — held together in a fist. Of a seed of secrecy, a threat, planted in the outer rind of his brain and nurtured until rootbound.

He is the Guard of the North
The warden of the wall
And he, too, is crushed under the fist

For he lives in a world of mice and men, where the cowards tether one below
Where one needs a sword to sever these ties that bind
Ties that cannot be remade
Where the weak are culled, and one must rise to live
So the walls must be taller, and the ascent higher
and the distance grows forever, until everything below is misty blue

The mist unites, so says the seed
In the Shroud, everything is whole, and all is one, and one is all
And so the right hand stretched out to deliver what it carries
A fist; a sword; an end
A cerulean thread to stitch two hearts as one

— Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard

Destiny draws near. Their cursed Citadel is closer than ever... and within it, their weapon. The fire which we ought to snuff out... The Mother Flame, which threatens to burn us alive. The source of their infinity, and lifeblood of their kind.

We must separate the mice from the men
The rats from the rulers
The Ancients from the ashes of rebirth

We must douse her. To unite everything. To become whole, so the Wanderer says.

He stood by my side, one step from the edge, arms stretched out wide.
"This is what the birds see." He said. "The birds of prey. High, far up above the rest... floating."

Why, yes. I should float. Above the rats. Above all. 
This is where I was meant to be from the beginning, and where I'm meant to bring forth the end. Though my heart aches... I will fulfill my duty.

— Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard

lore.c: The Shroud, Elixir, and Elixir Wells

p.t:
I keep hearing whispers in the dark. They're faint. Far away, but amplified... manifold. Layered. Like an echo that answers its own beck and call. A folded veil, descending on itself.

As I attempt to peel back the pleats, it feels as though I brush against skin above skin; skin where there should be none, should never have been.
A thing that grows and never stops growing, painting over itself with matter. A thing with many faces; crying from many mouths.
Heckling, deceiving, bantering.

Cinder's Cradle has finally done me in.
The others fell - or surrendered themselves - to the Shroud long ago... for me, the final stab was this sweltering heat... and all these... voices.

For the longest, I couldn't place them. I recognize them as unlike my own, unlike my comrades' or the Lord's...

Then, I realized it. When the Wanderer spoke, raising his fist firmly by Vorgoth's right side, I heard it.

I heard the voice of the whispers, split from many mouths.

He's always up there in that lonely tower.

Instead of parlaying with his men, or what's left of 'em, he's staring at the stars... why? It must be the Wanderer's doing. He's the one who's been infecting his mind; guiding his hand, his sword...

What answer, what wisdom could the moon overhead possibly hold? Is the Lord growing sentimental? No, it can't be. 

It must be his way of preparing for the siege.

Mushy humans found a way through barrier. They think they better than us. Not again. We went in just behind them. 
We dig. We mine. Every chunk of metal we tear from this rock is a blade, a shield, a dent in a mushy skull.
We take what should be ours.

They were first at the gate, 
we will be first at the top!

Our gods have risen. They chose lava earth for their kingdom and lifted their temples into the sky.
Would be easier for Drak'Fyr on volcanic ground. Easy for Drak'Ari drifting through sky. But we are Drak'Dal. We come from the ground.
There has to be reason this great challenge is ours. The final trial has begun.
We are worthy. We will succeed. Human demise is settled.

Stupid, stupid fishies!

Always flee Kra'Tau's arrows! Rah!
Think they can outsmart Kra'Tau? Think again!

Kra'Tau throw bow into pond. Useless! No one need coward weapon like that! Kra'Tau catch fishies with claws, then stomp with feet. Make fish soup the old-fashioned way!

Then silly fishies no laugh at Kra'Tau missing shots! Fishies won't laugh at all no more —  fishies stomped dead!!

Rah rah!

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Balthazar
p.t:
The Alchemist needs shelter to work. Build a home for the Alchemist and grant him access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.

The Alchemist wants to craft a Spiritual Cane. Staffs use spell charges, channels, or eternal spells as ammunition and are powerful magical weapons. Crafting the staff requires Shroud Wood, which can be found beneath the Shroud.

The Alchemist is convinced that another Ancient Vault may house survivors which could help with base building and storage.

Find the Ancient Vault he mentioned!

You've found the entrance to the Ancient Vault. The survivor must be inside somewhere. 

Reach the end of the Ancient Vault to reach the sleeping survivor!
The Carpenter could be saved! He needs to be summoned and placed in the base.
The Alchemist mentioned the location of a legendary Glider. The spot is marked on the map.
The camp the Alchemist mentioned is right by an ancient Sun Temple. The legendary Glider must be inside.

The Alchemist mentioned that certain spells are imbued with endless magical energy. Such spells are called eternal spells, and they don't deplete when used as staff ammunition. They can be used indefinitely.

These spells are scattered throughout the world, but one was buried alongside its former owner in an underground grave. Find the buried tomb and retrieve the eternal spell to use it.

c.t: Pick up Eternal Ice Bolt I

p.t: You've found the buried tomb home to an eternal spell. Enter the tomb and find the spell to make its power yours!

c.t: Pick up Eternal Ice Bolt I

quests.n: A Black Cauldron For The Alchemist

p.t: You found an old Black Cauldron. Use it to make an Alchemy Station and place it in your base to unlock more crafting possibilities.

quests.n: A Black Cauldron For The Alchemist

p.t: The Alchemist needs a Black Cauldron to establish an Alchemy Station. He heard stories of a sorcerer called Ikora from the Farmer, Emily Fray. Perhaps she knows more.

c.t: Place Alchemy Station for the Alchemist

p.t: The Farmer said that Ikora used to reside in Rattlebleak, a town in the the Nomad Highlands. Perhaps the Black Cauldron can be found at her shop.

c.t: Place Alchemy Station for the Alchemist

p.t: Ikora's shop is empty, and Rattlebleak is filled with strange, calcified statues. Perhaps this is related to Ikora's experiments with the Black Cauldron. Following the trail of statues might lead to her.

c.t: Place Alchemy Station for the Alchemist

p.t: Ikora, or what was left of her, was defeated. The Black Cauldron must be among her remains. The Alchemist will have use for it.

c.t: Place Alchemy Station for the Alchemist

p.n: Find And Prepare For The Hollow Halls
p.t:
The Alchemist spoke of the "Hollow Halls" — underground crypts, sealed tombs holding the "Hollow": walking skeletal remains. Find the Hollow Halls in the Springlands, and learn what's kept buried there.

The Halls do not forgive the unprepared. Stock food, potions, bandages, ammo... and armor up. Bring a team if you can..

You've found the Springlands Hollow Halls. Descend when you're ready — but know this: the Halls run deep, and the Hollow do not fall quickly. There is no rushing this fight.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

You've discovered a new survivor in the Hollow Halls. 

Place them in your home with a summoning staff to proceed.

The Alchemist has heard rumors of strange happenings in the Springlands. A group of Scavengers are abusing the Elixir and conducting cruel and unusual experiments.

Seek out their camp and smite them down to unlock an improved tool.

Slaying the Scavenger Matron at the Hill of Scavengers unlocked knowledge to craft an Improved Grappling Hook. 

The improved tool will require less stamina to use. Craft it with the help of the Carpenter.

Slaying the Scavenger Matron at the Hill of Scavengers unlocked knowledge to craft an Improved Grappling Hook. 

The improved tool will require less stamina to use. Craft it with the help of the Carpenter.

The Alchemist mentioned that his old home in Lone Thistle attracted cats because of a rat infestation. Even after all these years, there's a chance that some cats still populate the area. 

Craft cat food bait with the Farmer for taming a stray cat to proceed!
You've crafted the cat food needed to tame a stray cat. Now go to Lone Thistle and search the Alchemist's tower above the Shroud to find and tame a cat!

p.n: Find And Tame A Stray Cat
p.t: You've reached the Alchemist's tower. Search inside for a stray cat!

p.n: Place The Cat In Your Home
p.t: You've picked up the stray cat from the Alchemist's tower! Place it in your home to welcome it!

p.n: Craft A Cat Bowl And A Cat Bed
p.t: You've placed the cat in your home! Now craft a cat bowl and a cat bed to make your new pet happy!

The Mortar was found inside the Alchemist's hidden laboratory behind a closed door. It should be returned to its rightful owner. 

Placing the Mortar in the base will enable new crafting recipes.
Find the Alchemist's Mortar in order to unlock more crafting recipes. It's hidden in the Alchemist Tower in Lone Thistle, somewhere below the surface.
You've reached the Alchemist's tower! Search his basement to find his laboratory!

p.n: Find A Way Inside The Laboratory
p.t: The door to the Alchemist's underground laboratory seems to be locked, but his Mortar should be inside. There must be some sort of hidden mechanism to open it somewhere in the tower.

You've discovered a button in the Alchemist's tower!

Perhaps this button has opened the door to the basement downstairs? Proceed onwards and gather the mortar from the basement!

The Mortar was found inside the Alchemist's hidden laboratory behind a closed door. It should be returned to its rightful owner. 

Placing the Mortar in the base will enable new crafting recipes.

p.n: Uncover The Secrets Of The Hidden Tomb
p.t: The alchemist told you about a mad wizard obsessed with creating a spell for eternal life. He allegedly conducted his experiments deep underground, where no one could see what he was truly doing. It’s uncertain if he ever achieved the spell he sought — but he did create something. Go to the hidden tomb where he is said to have worked, and search for any traces of him.

p.n: Locate and Explore the Next Tomb
p.t:
You have found a record of the experiments the mad wizard conducted. Sadly, his work in this tomb was unsuccessful, but he cryptically noted where his next experiment would take place:
"From the water, I cross Gateway Outpost "Darkwater" and venture into the jungle to seek the next tomb."

Venture to the next tomb and uncover its secrets.

p.n: Locate and Explore the Next Tomb
p.t:
The wizard was indeed experimenting in this tomb, and you have also discovered one of his results: an eternal fireball. Yet he was unsatisfied with his creation and declared he would continue his journey to a hidden tomb behind the great tower in the lake, close to Goldrock Saddle.

Seek out this tomb and continue your search for the wizard’s spell experiments.

p.n: Locate and Explore the Next Tomb
p.t:
With this creation, the wizard came very close to his goal. Unfortunately, he had created a heal beam channel — one that grants life to others, not himself. In his egocentric mind, this was a disaster. He mentioned that the next tomb isn't far. He heard its more like a maze, and some race through it as a challenge. He is delighted at the thought, that many apprentices will be there.

The tomb is supposed to be close to the Mining Rift towards the Blackmire.

p.n: Locate and Explore the Next Tomb
p.t: The creature that seized the spell gave the wizard quite a fight. He had to hunt it down until they emerged on the other side of the tomb. Who would have thought this tomb was a tunnel? Yet again, he ended up creating a lightning spell — and still no eternal life spell. He already feels defeated, believing there is only one tomb left where he can attempt his experiments unnoticed. It's near Stillwater Bay towards the foot of the hills.

The wizard’s final experiment resulted in an eternal ice bolt spell. He believed he could use it to freeze himself and, in doing so, achieve eternal life — in a way.

Go back to the Alchemist and tell him about your findings.
The Scientific Instruments were retrieved! They must be brought back to the Alchemist and crafted into a Laboratory to unlock more recipes and better healing.

p.n: Search For Clues About Loraine Crim
p.t:
The Alchemist needs some Scientific Instruments to build a Laboratory. This will enable new crafting recipes and better healing. 

His old friend, Loraine Crim, used Scientific Instruments for her research. Her last known expedition led her to investigate an Ancient Obelisk. The spot is marked on the map.

A note reveals that Loraine Crim investigated an Ancient Dam before researching the Ancient Obelisks. She dropped her Scientific Instruments when her camp was attacked by vultures. The spot is marked on the map.
The Scientific Instruments were retrieved! They must be brought back to the Alchemist and crafted into a Laboratory to unlock more recipes and better healing.

p.n: Combine The Pieces In A Frame
p.t:
You've obtained both parts of the wall hanging! 

To decipher the meaning of its depiction, you must return home and place both pieces inside a frame! Combining the pieces will reveal more crafting recipes and enable you to create better mage armor with mauveine and purple fabric!

Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes. Since crafting recipes are shared serverwide, this collection must be assembled once per server to reap the benefits. 

This entry will be completed once the collection has been assembled on the server. XP rewards are only awarded once.

p.n: Reach The City Behind The Mountain Range
p.t:
The Alchemist requires new knowledge of the realms to proceed on his journey in alchemy! The Flame has shown him a new source of wisdom beyond the mountain range — a lighthouse before a lake. 

Find a way into the mountains with the help of the Flame and search for the town!

Obtaining new alchemical wisdom should reveal more crafting recipes and enable the crafting of better mage armors!

You've reached the city by the lake. A part of the port has been swallowed by the Shroud, but a keen eye can spot the tip of a lighthouse not far away.

Reach the lighthouse and search the inside for a new source of wisdom!

p.n: Follow The Vultures To Their Nest
p.t:
You've entered the lighthouse and found half of a wall hanging. Its imagery depicts the makeup of complex alchemical solutions... or so you think. 
Without the other half, you can't fully decipher the meaning, but combining both pieces will reveal many new crafting recipes, including purple fabric for crafting better mage armor!

The lighthouse was seemingly attacked by vultures. Perhaps they took part of the wall hanging to their nests. 

Reach the vulture nests to find the second half of the schematic!

You've reached the nesting location of the vultures. The second half of the wall hanging cannot be far.

Search the vulture nests marked on your map!

p.n: Combine The Pieces In A Frame
p.t:
You've obtained both parts of the wall hanging! 

To decipher the meaning of its depiction, you must return home and place both pieces inside a frame! Combining the pieces will reveal more crafting recipes and enable you to create better mage armor with mauveine and purple fabric!

Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes. Since crafting recipes are shared serverwide, this collection must be assembled once per server to reap the benefits. 

This entry will be completed once the collection has been assembled on the server. XP rewards are only awarded once.

quests.n: Finding And Using A Gem Forge

p.t:
While researching, the Alchemist discovered that the Ancients once used gemstones as a natural power source for augmentation. The gems originated below the earth and have mysterious properties that allow them to cling to surrounding energies.

To harness the power of a gemstone, you will first need to know the location of a Gem Forge. Thankfully, the Alchemist knows where to look.

Reach the location marked on your map to proceed.

p.n: Clear And Investigate The Gem Forge
p.t: You've reached the location of the Gem Forge, but there are enemies nearby. Defeat the enemies inside the Gem Forge before taking a look around!

p.n: Find Out Where The Intruders Came From
p.t:
You defeated the enemies inside the Gem Forge and discovered that they were holding onto 
a resource called "Archaic Essence I". 

While the Gem Forge is still intact, the rest of the little sanctum is ransacked. Perhaps the Fell came here to claim the Archaic Essence I used in weapon augmentation for themselves.

Follow the footsteps of the Fell and find out where they took the stashed energy resource!

The Fell took the Archaic Essence I into a winding, enshrouded cave. What purpose are they after? 

Explore the depths of the Shroud Lair to proceed! Consider gathering more Archaic Essence I as you go forth to reclaim it from the Shroud!

p.n: Defeat And Loot The Fell Banshee
p.t:
The heart of the Shroud Lair is haunted by a Fell Banshee. The Shroud will continue to spread here and steal resources to fuel their own brood unless the Banshee is destroyed!

Defeat the Fell Banshee and claim her loot!

You've defeated the Fell Banshee and found a weapon gem! 

Take your newly acquired gem, a suitable weapon, and the Archaic Essence I back to the Gem Forge. 
Use these components to slot a gem into a weapon to empower it!

quests.n: A Cure For The Fell Curse

p.t:
Your last fight against the Fell left you scarred. You cannot grasp the situation yet, but whenever you enter the Shroud, the choking fog suffocates you much quicker.

You should ask the Alchemist about a cure to ensure this new ailment doesn't impact your vitality long-term.

c.t: Pick up Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic

p.t:
Your talk with the Alchemist was enlightening, but disturbing just the same.

You learned you were cursed on your last expedition into the Shroud. The ailment has long-term consequences for your vitality, and you will suffer from this malaise until you find a cure.

The cure can be made from materials that can be found above the Shroud at night, scattered among groups of Fell foes.

Gather the materials, craft the cure, and use it to cleanse yourself.

c.t: Pick up Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic

p.t:
Repeated exposure to toxins has thickened your blood, weakening you significantly.

You should ask the Alchemist about a cure to ensure this new ailment doesn't impact your vitality long-term.

p.n: Craft And Use A Hemotoxin Antidote
p.t:
The Alchemist has informed you that you're suffering from Hemotoxins. To craft a cure for this ailment, you must acquire spider glands and moths. 

The moths can only be caught at night.

Craft the hemotoxin antidote and use it!

You've retrieved the improved millstone. With it, you can craft a mill.

The mill will only function when there's a force generator nearby. A force generator can be a water wheel, which is placed in a water stream, or windmill sails. Both can be crafted at the Alchemist.

p.n: Discover An Easier Way To Grind Materials
p.t:
The Alchemist wants you to discover a more efficient way to grind materials. Perhaps you can discover a machine that functions without such manual labor!

Take a look around when you enter the Veilwater Basin. The Flame calls you towards a certain town that holds the answers you seek.

You've found a town called Riverreach. 

This place uses water to power a large lumber refinement complex and a mill. 

Reach the mill and observe how it operates to proceed!

The water-powered wheels are connected to a grinding apparatus inside a building, but you can't take the millstone while the machine is working.

Perhaps you could harness the power of water and turn the apparatus off.

Stop the water flow in Riverreach near the water wheels outside to turn the machine off.

p.n: Retrieve The Millstone While The Waterflow Is Turned Off
p.t:
You've successfully turned off the water flow in Riverreach. This enables you to retrieve the millstone.

Head inside to take the grind mill component. Remember that all water flow needs to be stopped to keep the machine turned off.

You've retrieved the improved millstone. With it, you can craft a mill.

The mill will only function when there's a force generator nearby. A force generator can be a water wheel, which is placed in a water stream, or windmill sails. Both can be crafted at the Alchemist.

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Oswald Anders
p.t:
The Blacksmith, Oswald Anders, requires a roof over his head and a sheltered bed to do his best work.

Certain crafting recipes require shelter as a condition. Therefore, it's advisable to keep your craftspeople sheltered and safe at all times.

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.

The Blacksmith feels a dark presence at the capital, Pikemead's Reach. He worries the town's fate might have been sealed by war, or worse, a strange and otherworldly glow from the depths of the riverbed.

The capital "Pikemead's Reach" has fallen, but there are no signs of the glow which the Blacksmith reported. The Blacksmith also mentioned a castle, which seems to be nestled just behind the city. Make your way through the town to enter the castle and see what awaits you there.
An eerie silence hangs over The Pike. Investigate the castle to determine the source of our nightmares, and the lights from below.

The Blacksmith needs a Smelter to craft better equipment. To craft a  Smelter, a Crucible is needed.

He suspects the Scavengers have his old Crucible at their mine in the Revelwood.
The Crucible was found. It needs to be crafted into a Smelter with the Blacksmith in order to unlock more crafting recipes.
The Crucible was found. It needs to be crafted into a Smelter with the Blacksmith in order to unlock more crafting recipes.

Some Smithing Tools were found in Jasper Isles. They must be for the Blacksmith. Place the Smithing Tools in the base to unlock more crafting recipes.

The Smithing Tools will allow you to craft advanced armor.

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t:
The Blacksmith asked to investigate a strange letter he received, signed by someone he doesn't recognize. The note was shipped by the Conways, couriers from the Nomad Highlands. Their shipment must've gone through the Trade Outpost "Blazing Rock".

Solving this mystery will allow you to craft better armor.

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t:
The following letter was sent to the Blacksmith: 
Dear Oswald, you're special to me in ways I can't even describe. Tall! Strong! A Blacksmith! What else could you want? I miss you and think of you daily. So what if we're oceans apart? My heart belongs to you only, you see, no matter the distance. The struggle of putting my feelings for you on paper keeps me awake at night. 

Reagan

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t: The shipment for the Blacksmith didn't come through Trade Outpost "Blazing Rock". It's theorized that the couriers, the Conways, traveled through Umber Hollow to save time.

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t: The Conway brothers traveled through Umber Hollow, where they were attacked. It seems like the Blacksmith was meant to receive an item, which was left behind in a town called Jasper Isles when the Conways fled. The note the Blacksmith received seems to be a fabrication of the Conways, since the original note was lost alongside a gift.

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t:
Some Smithing Tools were found in Jasper Isles. They must be for the Blacksmith. Place the Smithing Tools in the base to unlock more crafting recipes.

The Smithing Tools will allow you to craft advanced armor.

c.t: Place Smithing Tools for the Blacksmith

p.t:
You can craft new equipment at the Blacksmith. Craft with him to create a Scrappy Sword, a Spiked Club or any piece of armor.
 
Crafting the weapons requires Metal Scraps, which can be found in the world or dropped by Scavengers. A spot for collecting Metal Scraps is marked on the map.

This quest will also be completed if you beat the Elixir Well.

The Blacksmith wants to fight against the Shroud, the ruinous fog that has overtaken Embervale from the depths of the Elixir Wells. 

Reach the nearby Elixir Well to learn more about the Shroud!

It is recommended to equip sufficient gear, such as fur armor, for example. Eat food and rest in your base to acquire buffs before heading out.

The Elixir Well is an overgrown pit, spitting corruption and fumes into the air from below. 

Enter the Well to find the root of this evil and eradicate it!

It is recommended to equip sufficient gear, such as fur armor, for example. Eat food and rest in your base to acquire buffs before heading out.

The Shroud Root inside the Elixir Well will spread uncontrollably and harm Embervale. You have to put a stop to this.

Destroy the Shroud Root with a Felling Axe!

It is recommended to equip sufficient gear, such as fur armor, for example. Eat food and rest in your base to acquire buffs before heading out.

The Blacksmith says scaling the Ancient Spire will reveal more of the Springlands. The one he mentioned isn't too far from here.

Reach the Ancient Spire in the Springlands!

p.n: Enter And Ascend The Ancient Spire
p.t:
The Ancient Spire looms over the blighted land. There must be a way inside.

Enter the Spire and reach its top to proceed!

p.n: Speak To The Ancient Spire Flame
p.t:
By climbing the Ancient Spire, you've unlocked the ability to fast travel there.

You can also reveal information about the surrounding area if you talk to the Flame atop the Ancient Spire.

Speak to the Flame atop the Springlands Spire to proceed!

A Grappling Hook is vital for exploration. It can be used to swing across chasms or reach elevated locations. Look for Grappling Hook Pull Anchors in the world once you have crafted your Grappling Hook to use it.

You can craft the Grappling Hook at a Workbench. The Grappling Hook is needed to climb the Ancient Spire!

Crafting a Glider will allow you to reach distant locations or to cross enshrouded valleys unharmed. It can be crafted at a Workbench from Shroud Wood. 

You can aquire Shroud Wood by venturing beneath the Shroud.

Be wary of consuming Stamina while using the Glider to reach new locations.

Craftspeople can enhance your equipment.

The Blacksmith will upgrade most melee weapons, as well as shields, armors, and rings, in exchange for Runes. Legendary and rare weapons require Legendary Runes. 
Runes can be obtained through exploration or by salvaging equipment.

Salvage a piece of equipment to obtain Runes!

You've obtained Runes by salvaging an item.

Talk to the Blacksmith and use the Runes to enhance your equipment! You can choose a suitable melee weapon, shield, armor, or ring!

Enhanced equipment will empower you through newly unlocked perks.
The Blacksmith revealed the location of an iron mine under the Shroud. The spot is marked on the map.

The Blacksmith asked you to search for his daughter. She'd be great as a blacksmith assistant!

After you helped to retrieve a shipment for the Blacksmith from Umber Hollow, it's clear that the sender could've only been one person — Oswald Anders's estranged daughter. The parcel traveled through the Nomad Highlands back then, so the sender must've been from around or beyond there.

Investigate the area marked on your map to find the Blacksmith's daughter!
You've arrived at the last known location of Rochelle: A farm. Something about it feels off, though. One shed in particular seems to be in ruins. Search the ruins on the farm grounds for Rochelle!

quests.n: A Blast Furnace For The Blacksmith

p.n: Craft A Blast Furnace With The Bellows
p.t:
You've retrieved some bellows from inside the forge! They can be used to craft a blast furnace.

Return to your base and craft a blast furnace with the bellows to proceed!

c.t: Place Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith

quests.n: A Blast Furnace For The Blacksmith

p.t:
The Blacksmith is curious about the Albaneve Summits region. The North once expanded there to build more Elixir Well and crafted weapons from the local materials to protect them. These materials can only be smelted with the heat produced by a proper forge.

Find the forge and claim its heat source! This will enable you to craft a blast furnace.

c.t: Place Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith

p.n: Defeat The Enemies Inside The Forge
p.t: You've reached the forge, but it's teeming with Scavengers defending their equipment. Reach the heart of the forge and defeat the enemies there!

c.t: Place Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith

p.n: Craft A Blast Furnace With The Bellows
p.t:
You've retrieved some bellows from inside the forge! They can be used to craft a blast furnace.

Return to your base and craft a blast furnace with the bellows to proceed!

c.t: Place Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith

p.t:
The Blacksmith mentioned a way to mine gold underwater, but only the proper tools can facilitate this.

He noted that many gold shipments sent to the Capital used to come from a town called Orville. 

Reach this town and have a look around!

Orville seems infested with Drak'Dal. If there used to be any people here, then they and their tools are long gone by now.

Investigate the area to find clues.

The resident pearl divers of Orville tried to escape the invading Drak'Dal by swimming towards the shore opposite the bay. It was mentioned that, to remain hidden, the divers wouldn't be able to come up for air. They planned to hide in a collection of shipwrecks until the coast was clear to surface.

Swim to the shipwrecks near Orville and search for the Mining Sieve there!

The Blacksmith wants you to mine celestial ore in Cinder's Cradle. New materials will enable you to craft better gear!

A promising mining spot is marked on your map.
Reach the mine to proceed.

You've reached a promising mining spot for gathering celestium ore.

Gather celestium to proceed!

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Valory
p.t:
The Bard Valory requires shelter. Provide her with a nice, warm room to unlock more crafting possibilities. Build a home for the Bard and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.

The Bard of many titles, Valory, has tasked you with finding her lost daggers. She lost them while adventuring through a large mud-filled valley called the Tar Pits.

Reach the Tar Pits and explore the area!

You've reached the Tar Pits. Explore the valley and find the Bard's dagger to return it to her! 

Since Valory lost her dagger while fending off beasts, searching the lower levels where creatures reside might be a good idea.
The Bard wants you to retrieve the hand drum she lost while fleeing the Vukah. Reach their nearby settlement and have a look around!
You've reached the Vukah settlement by the giant tree. Climb to the top of the tree and search the settlement to find the lost hand drum!
The Bard shared a story of being shot by a seemingly enchanted arrow. Investigate the area and find the arrows to use their magic for good!

The Bard would like an assistant to play duets.

She believes that Cromville, a town in the Veilwater Basin, should house many musicians who could be promising candidates.

Reach Cromville to proceed!

p.n: Search For A Bard Assistant In Cromville
p.t:
You've reached Cromville. The city is large and sprawling, so you're sure to find a pure soul here with a bit of luck.

Find the pure soul of a bard assistant in Cromville to proceed!

p.n: Find Hints To Aunt Braelyn's Whereabouts
p.t:
The Carpenter wants some helping hands around the base. He mentioned his aunt Braelyn and wondered if she could be brought back from the dead like the villagers. He used to receive mail from her whenever she was out on adventures, but she went missing ages ago while scouting the Blackmire for interesting architecture.

She seemed especially interested in temples, towers, and bridges. There's plenty of hidden temples in the Blackmire region, so start your search there!
It seems as though Aunt Braelyn ventured into the hidden temples of Blackmire to research the stonework. Perhaps you can find more traces of her in the other temples!
Aunt Braelyn moved on to yet another hidden temple. Find her next destination and search for her there!
Aunt Braelyn lies dead in the final hidden temple! Reach her body and rescue her soul so she can be summoned again inside your base!
The Carpenter needs a table saw to expand his abilities. A Table Saw requires Circular Sawblades to make, and he thinks those can be found in a town called Thornhold.

c.t: Place Table Saw for the Carpenter

p.t: Thornhold has fallen to Scavengers. The town has been looted, and there are no Circular Sawblades to be found. Perhaps there are clues nearby.

c.t: Place Table Saw for the Carpenter

p.n: Find The Circular Sawblades In The Scavenger Camp
p.t: The Scavengers are taking their loot away in wagons. The Circular Sawblades must have been taken to a nearby encampment. Following the road should lead one there.

c.t: Place Table Saw for the Carpenter

p.t: The Circular Sawblades had been taken away by Scavengers to a nearby camp. Now, the Circular Sawblades must be crafted into a Table Saw. The Carpenter knows how.

c.t: Place Table Saw for the Carpenter

p.t: The Carpenter noticed that you have the knowledge and means to craft an improved version of the glider. Gather the materials and craft or obtain the new advanced glider with the Carpenter to stabilize your flight!
The Masonry Tools were found in an excavation camp in the Pillars of Creation. They should be brought to the Carpenter so he can build more crafting stations.

c.t: Place Masonry Tools for the Carpenter

p.t:
The Carpenter told you about a trader called Mei. She has decorations and items focused on the Lunar New Year. She can also sell cosmetic items.

She'd often visit the Low Meadows and always had the same route. 

Find the trader to gain access to new decorations and wares!

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Cade Hawthorn
p.t:
The Carpenter needs shelter for woodworking. Build a home for the Carpenter and grant him access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
Some Circular Sawblades were found. They can be crafted into a Table Saw with the Carpenter to enable more advanced crafting recipes.

c.t: Place Table Saw for the Carpenter

p.n: Speak To Emily Fray About Elin's Curse
p.t: It is said that one of the Carpenter's aunts, Elin, was cursed in a Kindlewastes Sun Temple once. It's not clear if the story is exaggerated, though. The Farmer, Emily Fray, is from the Kindlewastes and might have insight about the haunted Sun Temple.
The Farmer confirms that the Sun Temple in Brittlebush is indeed haunted! An evil spirit has haunted the holy halls ever since the Shroud flooded the land. It must be cast out!

p.n: Defeat The Specter In The Haunted Sun Temple
p.t: You've reached the entrance of the Haunted Sun Temple. Now it's time to step inside and lift the curse! Find whatever is haunting the Haunted Sun Temple and defeat it!
The Carpenter needs Masonry Tools to unlock more crafting stations. The Masonry Tools can be gathered from a research site at the Pillars of Creation.

c.t: Place Masonry Tools for the Carpenter

p.n: Uncover The Masonry Tools In The Research Camps
p.t: The research site within the Pillars of Creation houses a gigantic, strange structure. Excavation camps are scattered about. One of these camps must contain Masonry Tools.

c.t: Place Masonry Tools for the Carpenter

p.t: The Masonry Tools were found in an excavation camp in the Pillars of Creation. They should be brought to the Carpenter so he can build more crafting stations.

c.t: Place Masonry Tools for the Carpenter

p.t:
The Carpenter suspects that the Drak might be hiding all sorts of riches inside their sunken temples. He's sending you out to explore one of them in the hope of procuring some gold coins.

With the gold coins, you will be able to decorate your base and show your wealth.

Reach the temple and look around for treasures!

You've found the Drak temple the Carpenter mentioned. Now you must discover a way inside.

Keep your eyes open! If you're struggling to find the entrance, consider adopting a different perspective — perhaps one from below?

You've triggered a trap. It's time to act!

Find all the buttons to open a path out of the flooding temple! The upper levels will hold the treasure you seek!

You've survived the water temple, but you still haven't found its final treasure.

Look around in the upper layer of the temple to find its hidden gold chest!

The Carpenter told you about the Drak's ability to create different colored lights. He wants you to search their places and understand how they managed to do that.

When visiting Drak locations, it's best to take a Drak Soulward Flask with you.
You've reached the Drak'Dal Ruin. Now search for any hints on how the Drak'Dal create different colored lights.

You have read a note which describes how the Draklings need a warm light source to hatch and how they create this fiery glow with daylilies.

Go back to the Carpenter and tell him about your findings.

The Carpenter thinks that you may be able to add traps, levers, buttons, and other mechanisms to your base if you find the right tool. 

The Ancients use traps and other fare in their Night Sanctums. Perhaps such a Night Sanctum could hide the information or tools we need to copy their craft!

Reach the Night Sanctum marked on your map to proceed!

You've reached the Night Sanctum in question. The tool you need must be somewhere nearby. 

Look around to obtain the tool!

p.n: Craft And Place The Sparkworks Workbench
p.t:
You've acquired the logic tool you need to modify logic connections. 

Craft the Sparkworks Workbench at the Carpenter and place it in your base to complete the quest!

You can find many useful logic props at this workbench!

p.n: Craft And Place A Quick Stack Station
p.t:
The Carpenter has built his latest invention — a station that automatically stacks items from your backpack into nearby chests. See it in action for yourself. 

Craft a Quick Stack Station and place it in your base to complete the quest.

c.t: Pick up Large Quick Stack Station

p.t: The Carpenter revealed that he hid a treasure inside the middlemost pillar of the Braelyn Bridge as his trademark. Identify the middle pillar and break through the rubble to find that chest!

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Athalan Skree
p.t:
The Hunter needs shelter to craft provisions and supplies. Build a home for the Huntress and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
The Hunter remembers where another Ancient Vault was built, and believes it houses another sleeping survivor. Recovering this survivor should aid in food production and cultivation.
Another survivor could be uncovered! A Farmer will be helpful for food production once placed in the base.
The Hand Spindle was left behind in an abandoned Hunter's camp. It needs to be returned to the Hunter and placed in the base.

c.t: Place Hand Spindle for the Hunter

p.t: The Hunter needs her Hand Spindle back to craft better armors. She lost it near Westcott.

c.t: Place Hand Spindle for the Hunter

p.t: The Hunter didn't stay at the inn in Westcott. She avoids human contact. Instead, she must have set up camp close by. Her Hand Spindle cannot be far.

c.t: Place Hand Spindle for the Hunter

p.t: The Hunter traveled through Revelwood to reach Westcott. Her Hand Spindle was left in a different camp.

c.t: Place Hand Spindle for the Hunter

p.t: The Hand Spindle was left behind in an abandoned Hunter's camp. It needs to be returned to the Hunter and placed in the base.

c.t: Place Hand Spindle for the Hunter

quests.n: In Need Of A Tanning Station

p.t:
The Hunter wants to prepare fur and leather by drying it in the sun. She wonders if Nomad Highlands hunters could have tools and knowledge about it, but doesn't know any. 

Perhaps somebody else knows a Hunter from the area.

c.t: Place Tanning Station for the Hunter

p.t:
The Carpenter knows a fearsome Hunter from the Nomad Highlands. She was as big as a mountain and capable of taming animals. 
She was sent to Raven's Keep after a gruesome fight. 

This Hunter might have owned a Tanning Station.

c.t: Place Tanning Station for the Hunter

p.n: Obtain The Tanning Station From Lupa's Lair
p.t:
The residents of Raven's Keep have escaped. They fought through hordes of Vukah to break out, led by their new matron. They seem to have moved on to Lupa's Lair.

Perhaps the Tanning Station can be obtained there.

c.t: Place Tanning Station for the Hunter

p.t:
Lupa's Lair contained a valuable Tanning Station. The Hunter should be happy to learn about it. 

Place the Tanning Station to unlock more recipes.

c.t: Place Tanning Station for the Hunter

quests.n: In Need Of A Tanning Station

p.t:
Lupa's Lair contained a valuable Tanning Station. The Hunter should be happy to learn about it. 

Place the Tanning Station to unlock more recipes.

c.t: Place Tanning Station for the Hunter

p.n: Find The Weaver's Cottage In East Lapis
p.t: The Hunter needs a Loom to craft padding kits for better armor. She suggests looking for a weaver's cottage in East Lapis. The general area is marked on the map. The cottage should be easy to spot since its decorated with banners.

c.t: Place Spinning Wheel for the Hunter

p.n: Search The Weaver's Cottage For The Loom
p.t:
The weaver's cottage in East Lapis was found. The Loom for the Hunter should be somewhere inside. 

It must be recovered in order to craft padding kits and better armor.

c.t: Place Spinning Wheel for the Hunter

p.t: The Loom was retrieved. It should be placed in the base to unlock padding kits for better armor.

c.t: Place Spinning Wheel for the Hunter

p.t: The Loom was retrieved. It should be placed in the base to unlock padding kits for better armor.

c.t: Place Spinning Wheel for the Hunter

p.n: Reach The Mine And Acquire Salt
p.t: The Hunter, Athalan Skree, has given the location of a nearby salt mine. Salt is required to preserve fur.

The Hunter explained that a Spinning Wheel can be used to create linen and string in more cost-effective ways. 

Craft a Spinning Wheel at the Huntress and place it to enable more cost-effective crafting options.

The Hunter told you about a town that used to be overrun by stray dogs. Perhaps some dogs are still there. 

Craft dog food bait to tame and rescue a dog!
You've crafted the dog food bait needed to tame a stray dog. Now reach Thornhold and look for dogs to tame there!
You've reached Thornhold, but the town has been claimed by Scavengers. Look around to find the stray dog!

p.n: Place The Dog In Your Home
p.t: You've obtained a new furry best friend. Bring them home to your base and place them there! Maybe they will let you pet them?

p.n: Make A Dog Bowl And Dog Bed
p.t:
Your new friend is merrily strolling around your base. They would be even happier if you made a dog bowl and a dog bed for them! 

Craft and place both items to proceed!

quests.n: A Spinning Machine For The Hunter

p.n: Craft A Spinning Machine With The Huntress
p.t: The Huntress needs a Spinning Machine to refine raw wool. Craft a Spinning Machine with her to proceed!

c.t: Place Spinning Machine for the Hunter

p.t:
You've crafted a Spinning Machine. Now place it in your base to enable the wool refinement process!

After that, you should create refined wool for warm padding kits and better armor!

c.t: Place Spinning Machine for the Hunter

p.t:
The refined wool can be used to craft warm padding kits. These kits are essential for crafting warmer gear. 

Craft warm padding kits with the huntress to proceed!

c.t: Place Spinning Machine for the Hunter

p.n: Craft Or Obtain A Drak Soulward Flask
p.t:
The Hunter thinks that you must spill and drink the same blood as the Drak to beat them at their own domination game.

Craft or obtain a Drak Soulward Flask to strengthen yourself against the new foes! You can find the recipe at the Alchemist's workshop.

While under the influence of the potion, you will also gain the ability to understand their written language.

You've crafted a potion that allows you to fight against the Drak more effectively. 

Drink the potion before or during battle to feel its empowering effects. After consumption, you will also be able to read the written word of the Drak.

The Huntress believes that you could further extend the lengths of your dives with the right tools. She revealed that the northern army once trained specialty divers and equipped them with proper tools for extended missions.

The divers were last deployed at a Drak temple, which was abandoned at the time.

Reach the Drak temple to proceed!

p.n: Enter The Temple And Loot The Lost Diver
p.t:
You've found the Drak temple the Huntress mentioned. Find a way inside and prove your prowess.

A part of the temple seems to be flooded. Increasing your maximum oxygen before entering is recommended.

Once you're inside the temple, you must discover the fate of those who dove here before you and retrieve their gear.

The Huntress asked you to gather some fireflies. She didn’t say what she plans to do with them, but it’s best to go along with it. 
Fireflies can be found in the Springlands at night.

Return to her with the fireflies in your inventory.

The Huntress explained that she wants to hook the fireflies onto a fishing line to catch fish. She also showed you how to craft a basic fishing rod. 

Craft a fishing rod, then return to her.
You're ready to catch your first fish. Hook the bait onto your rod and head to any body of water large enough for fishing. Come back to show her what you’ve caught!

The Huntress has stated that the Ancients were adept at using both mechanical and ethereal means to achieve their goals. She is interested in their magically infused weapons, ammunition, and constructs. 

Reach a place where many Ancient constructs were deployed to better understand Ancient craftsmanship.

You've reached a flying island which teems with mechanical constructs and machinery. 

If you look around thoroughly, you may discover discarded research or blueprints that will unlock new crafting recipes for magically empowered items!

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Emily Fray
p.t:
The Farmer needs shelter to make her crafts. Build a home for the Farmer and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.

p.n: Craft And Place A Cooking Station
p.t:
A Kettle was uncovered, laying among remains in a Flame Sanctum. An etching at the bottom reads "Keep safe, Raúl! — Emily Fray". 

The Kettle must be used to craft a Cooking Station. This will enable more cooking recipes.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

p.t:
The cooking station was just the first piece of equipment the farmer requested. It’s perfect for simple tasks like grilling or preparing single ingredients. But to truly unlock her full culinary potential, you’ll need to craft her a kitchen. There, she’ll be able to cook any dish you desire.

Craft and place a kitchen to complete the quest.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

p.t:
The Farmer wants a Kettle as her first cooking equipment. She suggests looking for her friend, a man named Raúl, in Pikemead's Reach to get her Kettle back.

To reach Pikemead's Reach, Shroud Passage Level 3 is required. Increase the Passage Level by strengthening the Flame.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

p.n: Find The Kettle In Pikemead's Reach
p.t: Pikemead's Reach has been ravaged. The Farmer's friend Raúl must be hiding in a safe place amidst the peril. Perhaps the Kettle can still be found somewhere.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

p.n: Craft And Place A Cooking Station
p.t:
A Kettle was uncovered, laying among remains in a Flame Sanctum. An etching at the bottom reads "Keep safe, Raúl! — Emily Fray". 

The Kettle must be used to craft a Cooking Station. This will enable more cooking recipes.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

p.t:
The cooking station was just the first piece of equipment the farmer requested. It’s perfect for simple tasks like grilling or preparing single ingredients. But to truly unlock her full culinary potential, you’ll need to craft her a kitchen. There, she’ll be able to cook any dish you desire.

Craft and place a kitchen to complete the quest.

c.t: Place Cooking Station for the Farmer

quests.n: Almanac of Plants and Seedlings For The Farmer

p.n: Place The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings
p.t: The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings could be found in Surat's Rest. It should be placed in the base to grow better crops.

c.t: Place Almanac of Plants and Seedlings for the Farmer

quests.n: Almanac of Plants and Seedlings For The Farmer

p.n: Look For The Abandoned Caravan Camp
p.t: The Farmer asked for an Almanac of Plants and Seedlings to grow new crops. Her old almanac was lost on her journey through the Nomad Highlands when she had to abandon a campsite. Her Almanac of Plants and Seedlings should be where she and her caravan had set up camp.

c.t: Place Almanac of Plants and Seedlings for the Farmer

p.t: The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings was looted by Scavengers. They took their loot to Surat's Rest.

c.t: Place Almanac of Plants and Seedlings for the Farmer

p.t: The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings was gifted to a "matron" in Surat's Rest. The matron must be defeated so that the Almanac of Plants and Seedlings can be returned to the Farmer.

c.t: Place Almanac of Plants and Seedlings for the Farmer

p.n: Place The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings
p.t: The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings could be found in Surat's Rest. It should be placed in the base to grow better crops.

c.t: Place Almanac of Plants and Seedlings for the Farmer

p.t: The Farmer wants to trade a little secret in exchange for some strawberries to satisfy her sweet tooth. The berries can be grown and harvested through advanced crafting, but they also appear in the Revelwood.

p.n: Find Treasure In The Landfill At Glennwood's End
p.t:
You gave the Farmer strawberries. Their flavor reminded Emily of her old home, which used to be a bountiful oasis before disaster struck.

In exchange for the berries, she revealed the location of a buried treasure in the trash pit of Glennwood's End. Explore the location and dig up the hidden riches!

p.n: Investigate Emily Fray's Tavern In Brittlebush
p.t:
The Farmer wants to make beehives and honey, but lacks a Beehive Smoker. Ages ago, she ordered a Beehive Smoker to her tavern in Brittlebush, but her shipment didn't arrive before she left. The Beehive Smoker unlocks the ability to craft a Honey Beehive.

Search for Emily Fray's tavern in Brittlebush to look for clues and retrieve the Beehive Smoker.

c.t: Place Beehive Smoker for the Farmer

p.t: The Beehive Smoker was sent from East Lapis, but didn't arrive. Investigating the trade route will reveal more clues. The spot is marked on the map.

c.t: Place Beehive Smoker for the Farmer

p.t:
The Beehive Smoker was stolen and brought to the Vukah Sacrifice Hill, alongside honey and wax. 

Follow the trail and eliminate the Vukah thief to retrieve the Beehive Smoker. This will unlock Honey Beehives and honey production.

c.t: Place Beehive Smoker for the Farmer

p.t: The Beehive Smoker was found. It must be placed in the base to unlock the Honey Beehive, which enables a regular supply of honey.

c.t: Place Beehive Smoker for the Farmer

p.t: The Beehive Smoker was found. It must be placed in the base to unlock the Honey Beehive, which enables a regular supply of honey.

c.t: Place Beehive Smoker for the Farmer

p.n: Climb The Ancient Spire In The Revelwood
p.t:
The Farmer, Emily Fray, wants you to conquer the Ancient Spire in the Revelwood.

Reach the top of the Ancient Spire to unlock a Fast Travel point in the new region and new points of interest on your map.

p.n: Make Or Obtain 3 Goat Baits With The Farmer
p.t:
The Farmer has recipes for different animal food baits needed to tame animals. Make goat food baits with the Farmer to tame your first farming animal!

You will most likely need at least 3 goat food baits to proceed meaningfully.

p.n: Find, Feed And Tame A Goat
p.t:
You've crafted some animal baits! Now it's time to find a goat.

To tame an animal, you must approach it carefully. Sneak to avoid alerting the animal. Select the food bait and throw it close to the animal to gain its attention. Wait for the goat to eat, and try to pet it while it is feeding to establish a bond. You will need to be close to pet the animal. 

Repeat the process until the animal begins to trust you. Once it is comfortable, you can pick it up.

p.n: Place The Farming Animal In Your Base
p.t:
You've tamed and picked up a farming animal! Take them home to your base and place them! 

Your farming animal will roam around, so consider building an enclosure!

p.n: Craft A Farming Animal Feeder And Bed
p.t:
You've placed the goat. Now, you should craft and place the necessary amenities. 
To satisfy your animal's needs, it will need a Common Goat feeder and a farm animal pillow. 

If you have 2 happy animals close to each other and an extra spare bed, the animals can reproduce.

Craft a goat feeder and a farm animal pillow!

quests.n: Gathering Wool In The Albaneve Summits

p.n: Make Or Obtain Yak Food Bait
p.t:
The Farmer mentioned that a Yak would be useful to produce wool. The wool could be used to craft warmer padding kits and armor that protects against the biting winds.

To tame a Yak, you must first craft food baits. Craft or obtain at least 3 Yak baits to continue.

Now that you've procured some Yak food bait, you have to search for a Yak! 

There is a spot marked on your map where Yaks can be found, but you can complete the quest anywhere.

Tame Yaks to proceed!

The Farmer stated that she would like to cook some new food. Certain recipes will keep you nice and warm when out in the snow! 

Consider cooking pumpkin soup, grilled fatty beef, or beef stew.

p.n: Craft Or Obtain A Diver’s Endurance Flask
p.t:
The Farmer is concerned about your safety during underwater combat. Facing foes underwater disables self-defense. Your only option is evasion and escape.

Crafting a potion that increases your maneuverability underwater will increase your chances of survival. 

You can find the recipe at the Alchemist's workshop.

You've crafted a potion that will enable more carefree movement underwater.

Consume the potion and try its effects for yourself to proceed!

The Farmer wants you to find and tame a Capybara in the Veilwater Basin. The bristles produced by this animal can be used in crafting. 

To tame a Capybara, you must first craft food baits. Craft or obtain at least 3 Capybara baits to continue.

You've filled your pockets with the needed food bait. Now it's time to look for a Capybara to tame!

An ideal spot for taming is marked on the map, but anywhere is possible. The quest will only update to the next page when you reach the designated area, but you can complete the quest by taming any Capybara.

You've reached the designated spot for taming a Capybara. Use your bait to tame an animal there. Remember to be careful as you approach!

Once the Capybara is comfortable, it can be picked up and brought home. It will produce bristles for you from then on.

The Farmer is tired of fish soup. She wants you to hunt down Crabs that live in Veilwater Basin, in and around bodies of water, so she knows what she can work with.

Come back to the Farmer with Crab Meat in your backpack.

c.t: Place Seafood Grill for the Farmer

p.n: Craft And Place A Seafood Grill
p.t:
The Farmer has found new inspiration for seafood dishes. She’s shown you how to craft a Seafood Grill.

Craft and place a Seafood Grill so she can begin preparing even better dishes.

c.t: Place Seafood Grill for the Farmer

p.n: Grill A Fish And Eat It
p.t:
According to the Farmer, grilling fish makes them far more nutritious — they can even boost your oxygen level. 

Cook a fish at the campfire, then eat it to see the effect.

p.n: Gather New Fruits, Vegetables, and Herbs
p.t:
The Farmer is curious about the crops that grow in Cinder's Cradle. She wants to familiarize herself with their flavors and traits.

Gather fruits, vegetables, and herbs from Cinder's Cradle!

A good spot for fruits and vegetables is marked on the map.

p.n: Bring Fruits, Vegetables, and Herbs To The Farmer
p.t:
You've gathered the new crops in Cinder's Cradle:

Prickle Pearl
Grandleaf Cabbage
Bloomheart Fruit
Aurora Beans
Thyme

Place all crops in your inventory and talk to the Farmer to proceed!

The Farmer wants to cultivate all the curious fruits and vegetables that you showed her. For this, you will need basalt farm soil.

Craft or obtain basalt farm soil to proceed!

p.n: Craft A Watering Can At The Blacksmith
p.t:
The Farmer Emily has asked you to craft a Watering Can with the help of Oswald Anders. A Watering Can is a useful tool for identifying the best soil for your crops and checking their growth stages. 

Craft one at the Blacksmith, then return to the Farmer with it in your inventory to proceed.

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For The Collector
p.t:
The Collector, who introduced themselves as Alden Crowley, requires shelter. They will be able to craft more once sheltered. Build a home for the Collector and grant them access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already!

To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed.

This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.

p.n: Craft A Revelwood Hollow Halls Key
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Revelwood. To enter, you will need a key. 

Craft the Key with the Collector to proceed.

The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Revelwood. Reach the location and descend to slay the one-eyed creature within, and take its head to enable new crafting options. 

Gather your strength and your allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.

The location of the Revelwood Hollow Halls were discovered. Fight your way to the end and smite down the one-eyed beast to obtain new crafting ingredients for the Collector.

This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and your allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.

You defeated a fearsome Hollow Cyclops at the bottom of the Revelwood Hollow Halls. 

Take its head and use it to craft an Ectoplasm Press. Place it to unlock better crafting options.

p.n: Craft A Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls Key
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Nomad Highlands. To enter, you will need a key. 

Craft the Key with the Collector to proceed.

p.n: Reach The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Nomad Highlands. Descend there and reach the end to please the Collector.

This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and your allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.

p.n: Master The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls
p.t: You've found the Hollow Halls in the Nomad Highlands. Descend and reach the end to please the Collector.

p.n: Craft A Kindlewastes Hollow Halls Key
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Kindlewastes. To enter, you will need a key. 

Craft the Key with the Collector to proceed.

The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Kindlewastes. Descend there and reach the end to please the Collector.

You will require a very high Shroud Passage Level to persevere. You should bring your best glider.
This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and your allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.
You've found the Hollow Halls in the Kindlewastes. Descend and reach the end to please the Collector.

p.n: Craft A Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls Key
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Albaneve Summits. To enter, you will need a key. 

Craft the Key with the Collector to proceed.

p.n: Reach The Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls
p.t:
The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Albaneve Summits.
Descend there and reach the end to please the Collector.

This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.

p.n: Master The Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls
p.t: You've found the Hollow Halls in the Albaneve Summits. Descend and reach the end to please the Collector.

The Collector has asked you to procure another shepherd of souls for him, or a blank slate that can be morphed into "something useful".

They pointed you to a promising location, which may house the undead shell you need.

Reach the temple in question  to proceed.

You've reached the temple of the Collector assistant.

Venture inside and re-emerge with the assistant in tow to please the Collector.

p.n: Craft A Veilwater Hollow Halls Key
p.t:
The Collector spoke to you about the Hollow Halls in the Veilwater Basin. To enter, you will need a key. 

Craft the Key with the Collector to proceed.

The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Veilwater Basin.
Reach the Hollow Halls to proceed!

This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.
You've found the Hollow Halls in the Veilwater Basin. Descend and reach the end to please the Collector.

The trader Mei sold a set of plants to the people of Fort Kelvin, but their beauty will fade with nobody around to admire them. 

Retrieve her plants from their previous owners so they can bloom inside your base! There are three plants in total, and all of them are found in Fort Kelvin.

p.n: Speak To The Carpenter About The Lantern
p.t:
The trader Mei told you she once sold a paper lantern to the carpenter, Cade. If she saw the lantern's design again, she could recreate them and offer them for crafting. 

Talk to the Carpenter and ask him about the lantern!

p.n: Search For The Lantern In Morwenna
p.t:
The Carpenter said that the lantern is in Morwenna, a town he used to reside in.

Go to Morwenna and search for the lantern!

p.n: Obtain A Keepsake From Your New Foes
p.t:
The Fisher spoke about a force that ravages the Veilwater Basin with maws like snapjaws, talons like vultures, and a thirst for blood. 

He wants you to slay one of these beasts and bring back a keepsake so you can better understand your new enemy. 

You can find these beasts anywhere, but a convenient location is marked on the map.

You've obtained Drak Scales while adventuring. They will serve as a good keepsake and proof of victory.

Speak to the fisher to proceed.

The Fisher thinks that defeating a Drak leader in a duel will weaken your foes. To challenge one of their commanders, you will have to prove yourself first.

Defeat 25 Drak to gain the attention of their leaders.

You can find Drak anywhere in the heart of the Veilwater Basin, or further out West. They're only found above the Shroud. A convenient place is marked on the map.

The carnage you've caused among the Drak does not go unnoticed. You've gained the attention of their leaders. It's time to challenge them!

You can find the Drak leaders in multiple places, but a convenient spot is marked on the map.

The Fisher told you an unlikely story of how he once grew fins to swim faster. While he's probably exaggerating greatly, there might be a hint of truth in his story.

His tale took place near Goldrock Saddle. Head there to proceed!

p.n: Search For A Tool To Swim Faster
p.t:
You've found Goldrock Saddle. 

Take a look around and discover a tool to swim faster, like the fisher suggested!
The Fisher has shared stories of his father’s clever fishing techniques. He wants you to collect some Frogs hopping around in the grass of the Veilwater Basin and bring them back to him.

The Fisher can craft you an Excellent Fishing Rod. With that, and Frogs as Fishing Bait, you will be able to catch epic fish — if your skills suffice.

Let the Fisher provide you with an Excellent Fishing Rod, then speak to him again.

The Fisher provided you with all the things you need to catch your first epic fish. A suitable location with a high chance for epic fish is marked, but they can be found anywhere in the Veilwater Basin.

Try your luck with your newly acquired Excellent Fishing Rod and Frog bait and show your catch to the Fisher afterwards.
