The Fisher told you about a special hiding spot, rumored to contain a chest with mariner's gear.

Find the hiding spot he mentioned! The place is marked on the map.

You've discovered the location that the Fisher told you about.

Look around to find the hidden chest with the fishing gear!

The Fisher wants to relive his glory days and has asked you to collect 10 epic fish for him. He believes that the water in Cinder's Cradle might be more likely to carry these extremely rare species.

You can collect any type of epic fish, but it must be at least 10 of the same kind.

A good fishing location is marked on your map, but you can go anywhere you like.

Return to the Fisher with at least 10 epic fish of the same kind in your inventory.

The Fisher is pleased with the epic fish you've procured.

He wants you to use your spoils to make fish tacos. Once you bring him fish tacos, he will tell you a story as a reward.
Prepare some fish tacos and speak to the Fisher to proceed!

The Fisher told you a story about a lovely mermaid. He wonders if similar stories exist in Cinder's Cradle, which are relatively barren and possess no large bodies of water to speak of.

Perhaps you will be able to find something of use when looking around old ruins with creeks or ponds.

quests.n: Claim A Spot For Your Base

p.t:
Embervale has fallen, consumed by the "Shroud". Bring back the light and reclaim the land by establishing a Flame Altar in the wilds!

A promising site to establish a Flame Altar is marked on your map. Reach the location to proceed.

c.t: Npc quest blacksmith unlocked if quest start skipped

p.t:
The Flame Altar will mark the spot for your base. In your base, you will later be able to craft and build shelter. Craft the Flame Altar and place it to establish your base. 

You don't have to place your Altar in the plains. You can choose any above Shroud area to establish your base.

c.t: Npc quest blacksmith unlocked if quest start skipped

p.t: The Flame Altar is built, but the land is still strange and unfamiliar. Speak to the Flame in your new base to learn how to proceed.

c.t: Npc quest blacksmith unlocked if quest start skipped

p.t:
The world is lost, but not barren. Survivors of the Shroud wait to be roused by your inner fire.

Find the sleeping survivor marked on your map. You will have to venture through the Shroud!
You've reached the location of the survivor! Find and awaken them.
You retrieved a survivor. Place them in your home with a Summoning Staff.

The Flame has instructed you to create shelter that will allow you to become Rested between adventures. Being Rested will increase your Stamina and Stamina Regeneration temporarily. 

To become Rested, you must spend time in a warm and comfortable environment. You can add Comfort to your home through furniture and decoration.
Additionally, you must be sheltered, sitting, or lying down. To create shelter, you must first craft a Workbench.

Craft or obtain a Workbench to proceed!
The Workbench recipe is available in your Manual Crafting tab.

p.n: Craft Or Obtain Rough Stone/Wood Blocks
p.t:
The Workbench can be used to craft many rudimentary items. It is especially useful for crafting Building Blocks.

Building Blocks are used to create structures around your Flame Altar. These structures, such as walls and ceilings, can provide you with shelter. 

Use the Workbench to craft Rough Wood Blocks or Rough Stone Blocks.

p.n: Craft Or Obtain A Construction Hammer
p.t:
You've made or obtained suitable Building Blocks. They will be useful for creating structures and shelter. Both you and other survivors will need shelter to function. 

The Blocks must be placed with a Construction Hammer. 

Craft or obtain a Construction Hammer in your Manual Crafting tab or at the Workbench to proceed!

You've crafted or obtained a Construction Hammer.

The Construction Hammer can be used to build structures with Building Blocks around your Flame Altar.

Place the Construction Hammer in your Action Bar and select it. Enter Building Mode and select the desired "Blueprint" and Building Block.
"Roof" structures require roof material blocks.

Use the Construction Hammer to build something around your Flame Altar!

Learning how to create basic structures with the Construction Hammer and Building Blocks has enabled you to build shelter.

Being sheltered fulfills one of the 3 conditions needed to become Rested: shelter, (or sitting, lying down) warmth, and comfort.

The next major condition you need to understand is warmth. You're warmed by spending time near a fire, such as a Flame Altar, campfire, or fireplace. The latter two are also necessary for cooking food, which provides helpful buffs.

Craft or obtain a fireplace to proceed!

The Flame wants to help you turn your base into a proper home.

A home will need furniture. Adding furniture and decoration to your base will also grant you more Comfort, which is necessary for becoming Rested.

Furniture allows you to sit or lie down. Lying down at night will pass the time faster until sunrise, and will forgo the challenge of fighting tough enemies in the dark.

Craft or obtain a bed  to add comfort to your home and to pass dangerous nights! A necessary mattress can be crafted at the Workbench!

c.t: Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Player got food buff after quest start

p.t:
You've obtained a bed, making your shelter feel more comfortable. Resting in an environment with high Comfort will increase the duration of your Rested Buff.

After a good night's sleep, you will need proper food to face the sunrise head-on.

Eating food grants you a Food Buff specific to the meal's type. Such Food Buffs are paramount to increase your stats or boost their regeneration. Before eating food, you must first prepare it.

Raw ingredients must be processed over an open flame or cooking station to become edible or unlock their full potential. A refined meal made of multiple elements is more effective than a single roasted ingredient. 

A Skewer, for example, has greater impact than plain game or vegetables. 
It must be assembled in your Manual Crafting menu before cooking. 

For now, process a skewer or any other raw food over a flame to proceed. Take care not to roast it for too long, or it will burn.

c.t: Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Player got food buff after quest start

p.t:
You've successfully processed your first food over a flame.

You can read about the benefits of each food item in your backpack. 
Check which food buff your processed food provides, and then eat it to complete the quest.

c.t: Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Pick up Large Boreal Wood Bed
Player got food buff after quest start

p.t: Skill Points can be spent in the Skill Tree. Open the Skill Tree and spend a Skill Point to obtain new abilities.

Lighting Ancient Spires unlocks Fast Travel points and knowledge about the surrounding area.

It seems like you haven't used the Fast Travel functionality yet. Open the map and select an Ancient Spire to use Fast Travel! 
You can also Fast Travel to your own Flame Altars.
The map shows the location of the Hunter in an Ancient Vault. She is adept at ranged combat and survival.
The Hunter must be summoned in the base in order for her to walk this plane once more! Summoning requires a Summoning Staff.
The map marks the location of the Alchemist, hidden in an Ancient Vault. They hold great knowledge and truth over potions and spells.
The Alchemist must be summoned in the base to provide his services! Summoning requires a Summoning Staff.

The Flame can be strengthened at the Flame Altar. This empowers you to pierce the Shroud further, and to construct more bases to protect Embervale from its reach.

In order to strengthen the Flame, Sparks and other materials are needed. Find Sparks in Flame Sanctums and Flame Shrines.
You've obtained a Spark. Use the Spark to strengthen the Flame at your Flame Altar. Strengthen the Flame at the Flame Altar to increase your Shroud Passage Level and to establish more bases.

Expand your home by upgrading the Flame Altar to increase your protection range. Upgrading the Flame Altar requires a Shroud Core, which is aquired by defeating boss enemies.

Increasing the range will give you more space to build in.

You can expand your home in different ways. Upgrading the Flame Altar increases the building range. Strengthening the Flame increases your protection against the Shroud and allows you to build more bases. 

Build a second Flame Altar in the outer wilds, anywhere you'd like.

The Flame spoke of "Ancient Obelisk" which reveal information about the world. The Obelisks show hidden truths, and some are connected to the Flame.

The location of one such Obelisk is marked on the map. Seek out the Obelisk and discover the secrets it holds. The Obelisk's secrets will only be revealed to those who seek them.

p.n: Read The Springlands Obelisk Of The Flame
p.t: Interact with the Ancient Obelisk to reveal its knowledge of the land and recollection of the past.

The Flame spoke of  "Ancient Obelisk" which reveal information about the world. The Obelisks show hidden truths, and some are connected to what festers below. 

The location of one such Obelisk is marked on the map. Seek out the Obelisk and discover the secrets it holds. The Obelisk's secrets will only be revealed to those who seek them.

p.n: Read The Springlands Obelisk Of The Shroud
p.t: Interact with the Ancient Obelisk to reveal its knowledge of the land and recollection of the past.

p.n: Forge A Path Through The Wild
p.t: The Flame has alerted you to a newly opened path into a desolate part of the Revelwood. Visit the area marked on your map to discover a widely untamed wilderness!

You've reached a mysterious new land named the Blackmire. The Flame's grasp is weak here, so you must strengthen its presence by igniting the Ancient Spire — Blackmire. Afterward, the Flame will be able to guide you more.

You awoke the Flame atop the Ancient Spire — Blackmire! It senses a presence below a nearby Ancient City that was swallowed by mud and soil. Discover the ruins and find the sleeping survivor to proceed!
There's a large central building in the Sunken Ancient City. Explore the area and find a way inside to discover the survivor within!
You've found a survivor slumbering deep below the Sunken Ancient City. Awaken them with a Summoning Staff!

The Flame explained that your power has grown tremendously. You can now reclaim the souls of those who perished while untouched by the Shroud or the Elixir. Investigate the area marked on your map to search for clues!

c.t: Spoken to fenrig mills new quest started

p.t: You've discovered a note that referred to a farmer called Fenrig. Follow him to the wolf cave he ventured to and explore the area!

c.t: Spoken to fenrig mills new quest started

p.t:
You've rescued a pure soul. Summon them in your base using a Summoning Staff. 

In the Summoning Staff menu, you can switch between different categories. Go to the "Assistants" category and summon Fenrig. Speak to him afterward!

c.t: Spoken to fenrig mills new quest started

p.t:
The Flame has told you about a new path to the snow-covered mountains. To reach this new frontier, you have to pass through a cavernous passage first. 

Travel through the cave passage and proceed into the mountains to spread your fire and call upon a new dawn!

p.n: Reach The Ancient Spire In The Albaneve Summits
p.t:
You've reached the Albaneve Summits! 

Extend the Flame's presence by igniting the Ancient Spire here so the light can guide you on your quest in these unknown lands!

p.n: Master The Ancient Spire In The Albaneve Summits
p.t:
You've reached the Ancient Spire in the Albaneve Summits.

Reach the top of the Ancient Spire and speak to the Flame to proceed!

The Flame has tasked you to slay the corrupted beast that dwells inside Howling Peak. 

Triumphing over this being will bring peace to the region and enable a new Flame upgrade, allowing Flame Altars to keep the cold at bay when building. 
To wake and draw out the beast, you must light the signal fires ("Balefires") that circle the innermost mountain. 

The first balefire is marked on your map. Reach the location to proceed!

You've reached the first location that holds a balefire. 

Approach the fire atop the tower near the end of the garrison and light it to proceed!

You've lit the first balefire, but your journey has just begun. To draw out the beast, all fires must be lit.

Look around you. From the position of each balefire, you should be able to see other structures in the distance. Each new structure will hold a balefire.
The final one is nestled on the mountain, very high up, in a town called Everfrore Keep.

There are 8 in total, and you must light them all to proceed.

p.n: Challenge The Beast On Howling Peak
p.t:
You woke the beast by lighting all balefires! It's time to end things. Reclaiming the Albaneve Summits and upgrading the Flame with the beast's head will enable you to build safely inside the cold!

Reach the top of Howling Peak and challenge the beast to a fight! The creature is strong, but not invincible. Some of its attacks can be parried.

Howling Peak is best reached by passing through Everfrore Keep.

quests.n: Increasing Your Follower Amount And Flame Level

p.n: Acquire Happy Villagers And Upgrade The Flame
p.t:
The Flame has informed you that it requires a larger number of followers to grow stronger. The Flame will feed off the people's faith, knowledge, and hope to increase its power. 

To acquire more followers, you have to find stray souls of villagers.
Once you have found the stray souls, you must provide them with shelter and food to make them happy. Afterward, you can upgrade the Flame to the next level and progress deeper into the world!

You've lit the Flame atop the Ancient Spire. You learned that, despite their remoteness, the frozen barrens did not remain untouched. Northern soldiers expanded their territory here and built Elixir Wells tainting the mountain's snow and archaic inhabitants.

You must seek the main Elixir Well and destroy the corrupted evil hiding within to reclaim the mountains! 

Don't go unprepared. You will need warm clothes, food, or torches to provide warmth in the harsh cold.
Wool and warm padding kits would be useful for crafting warm armor.

p.n: Defeat The "Evil Eye" Inside The Elixir Well
p.t:
You've reached the main Elixir Well. 

Delve into its depths and behead the one-eyed monsters within to fight back the Shroud!

The Fell Cyclops Head you've gathered can be used to upgrade the Flame.

Feed its power back into the fire to triumph over the Albaneve Summits and press further into the mountains!

The Flame senses a barrier, built by the elder Ancients, that inhibits its reach and vision. Whatever is hidden behind the barrier is invisible to the Flame — making it all the more interesting for you.

Reach and investigate the dark barrier!

p.n: Open The Night Door And Explore The Sanctum
p.t:
You've reached a location known as a "Night Sanctum". The barrier you've set out to investigate revealed itself to be a door. However, the star and moon ensemble decorating its facade indicates this to be no ordinary door, and it doesn't seem susceptible to force.

Find a way to open the night door and explore the inside of the temple!

You found a sleeping survivor in the bowels of the Night Sanctum! 

Summon the survivor with a Summoning Staff to continue!

The Flame has notified you about a disturbance in nearby waters. Unknown, new lands require your aid — but to understand the threat plaguing the shores, you will need help.

First, you must reach the passage that leads into the newly opened valley!

p.n: Traverse Through The Veilwater Basin Passage
p.t:
You've reached the passage leading to the nearby Veilwater Basin. 

 Proceed through the passage and reach the other side to gain a glimpse of the new, glistening blue horizons beyond!

p.n: Search For Clues To Find A Guiding Soul
p.t:
You successfully set foot in a new area — the Veilwater Basin. 

The Flame said that traversing these lands and fighting the brewing threat within will require aid. You feel called to investigate a nearby settlement for clues towards a pure soul that can steer you on the right path.

You've learned about an old sea captain. Perhaps this person could be ideal for guiding you through these unknown waters and the dangers that lie beneath.

The captain often traveled to a nearby island. Reach the island and search for the remains of a pure soul there!

p.n: Summon And Speak To The Captain
p.t:
You've found the soul of Melville Fontane, a retired captain turned innkeeper and fisher. 

Summon him to learn more about the Veilwater Basin!

p.n: Master The Ancient Veilwater Basin Spire
p.t:
The Flame wants you to conquer the Ancient Spire in the Veilwater Basin.

Reach the top of the Ancient Spire to unlock a Fast Travel point in the region and new points of interest on your map.

The Hydrak'Dal Head you've gathered can be used to upgrade the Flame.

Gather all other materials necessary to complete the upgrade. Afterwards, you will be able to travel deeper into the Veilwater Basin.

The Flame's light seems to be increasingly disturbed by the Shroud, thus weakening its reach and ability to guide you.

Therefore, you've been tasked to strengthen the Flame once more. You will need a special relic, which can be found inside a throneroom. Its location is marked on your map.

Upgrading the Flame will enable you to breach the deadliest Shroud yet and will give you access to new areas.

You've reached the Throneroom. 

The crown you seek must be somewhere inside. Find and collect the crown to proceed!

You've obtained the crown in question.

Now, you must use it to empower the Flame. Facilitate a Flame upgrade to proceed and to be able to investigate the Shroud's machinations!

The Flame has instructed you to apprehend the great evil which it senses is approaching. To face this adversary, you must enter the cradle of the Ancients.

The ideal entry point, an Ancient gate, is marked on your map.

Reach the Ancient gate to proceed.

You've reached the gate and are now able to proceed into the land of the Ancients.

The Flame mentioned a "heart of cinders", presumably a central point of great significance.

Reach the centre of the Ancient kingdom to proceed.

You've reached a platform in the midst of Cinder's Cradle called "Cinder's Ascent". 

The platform seems rather empty and inactive. There must be a way to reactivate it to reach the floating isles above. Thankfully, you sense the echo of a lost soul nearby. Perhaps they could be of help.

Look around Cinder's Ascent to proceed!

p.n: Summon The Ancient Researcher And Speak To Them
p.t:
You've discovered the soul of an ancient researcher! Perhaps they will be able to shed light on the situation.

Summon them and speak to them to plan your next moves!
Something, or someone, got imprisoned behind a wall of rubble at a Scavenger mineshaft. Find a way inside the mineshaft and gather what lies within!

p.n: Find The Chest Under The Stairs
p.t: A person who defended their home from Scavengers mentioned that they hid a chest somewhere in their house below the stairs. Perhaps the chest is still there.
The farmer in Woodgard buried a treasure in his mud-filled fields. Dig up the chest and claim his riches!

p.n: Find The Chest By The Church
p.t:
The church in Woodgard hides a chest inside. The villagers wanted to use materials stored inside to repair the roof. 

Find the chest and claim its contents for yourself!
The Vukah are gathering in the Low Meadows. Something mysterious might be afoot. Find their camp and investigate!
The Vukah have created a champion at their camp. Defeat the Vukah Brawler at the Vukah Ceremony Hill to return peace!
The Hunter, Athalan Skree, wants to see animal fur. She will share a secret with you once you bring some to her.
The Hunter shared the location of her hidden hunting grounds with you. Investigate the area to see what lies there!
You've discovered an Ancient Obelisk in the hunting grounds. Read it to uncover more hidden locations!
Something sinister has overtaken Glennwood's End, a large town in the far reaches of the Revelwood. Find the city and explore it!
Glennwood's End has fallen to Scavengers. Defeat the Scavenger Matron to cleanse the town and claim your trophy!
One of the survivors in your base has taken the Blacksmith's equipment chest. Ask around to find the culprit!
The chest was taken and subsequently lost by Cade Hawthorn. Reach his former camp and unearth the chest to claim its contents!
You've discovered writing from a man named Ramone Jones. He was a writer from the capital and editor of The Pike Weekly. Investigate his current whereabouts and try to find him!
You've discovered Ramone's supposed place of hiding. In a note, he talks about living in his friend's hidden cellar. Search the basement below the house to find Ramone!

A worker from the "Maelstrom" Construction Site suffered severe hallucinations and documented them as he descended into the Shroud.

Follow his footsteps and find out where he went!

p.n: Open The Hidden Chest At The Harbor
p.t: A resident of the harbor district in Pikemead's Reach hid a chest somewhere in his near-flooded basement. Find the chest and open it!
You've heard rumors of a collapsing cove near the capital. Explore the area and search for potential valuables!
Gormander's Treasure is rumored to have been buried somewhere in the Imperial Gardens of Pikemead's Reach. Find it!

p.n: Find And Enter The Hidden Attic
p.t:
You have reason to believe that one of the homes in the Imperial Gardens of Pikemead's Reach has a hidden attic, used for conducting magic rituals. 

Find a way to enter the attic and investigate it!

You've learned that the owner of the attic attempted to cross the threshold between life and death to reunite someone with a dead loved one. The "Ritual of Reunion" that was conducted seems to be the invention of "Lady Leclair" of Glennwood's End. 

Search for Lady Leclair's home in Glennwood's End and investigate it!

The originator of the "Ritual of Reunion", Lady Leclair, made changes to the incantation to slip into the realm of the dead and find eternal life. In her note, she mentions a basement. Find the entry to her basement and retrieve Lady Leclair!
There's contraband stashed somewhere in Surat's Rest. Find the spot and retrieve the loot!
A merchant was robbed while traveling through the Nomad Highlands. His demise can lead to your success! Find the left-behind loot near the giant bones!

You've found a note that mentions the appearance of a fearless fighter in the arena of Surat's Rest. She was killed in an unfair fight and her body was dropped down the cliff. Find her body and save her soul!
You found a note and map detailing the location of a nearby "oasis". Follow the route of the traveler who was looking for the oasis to learn more!
You're one step closer to finding the small Kindlewastes oasis. Follow the route of the traveler further to find the oasis, and any treasures hidden there!
The oasis the traveler was looking for wasn't far. Use your glider or other means to reach the oasis and unearth the treasures there!
The Hunter pointed you toward a large Scavenger camp in the Kindlewastes. Reach the camp and explore or snuff out the enemies there!
You've discovered the location of a forgotten Flame Shrine in the Kindlewastes. Reach and explore the location to gather a Spark!

Notes from the researcher Loraine Crim detail the location of obelisks in the Revelwood, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes. 

Read the obelisk in the Revelwood to proceed!

Read all the above-mentioned obelisks to finish the quest!

Notes from the researcher Loraine Crim detail the location of obelisks in the Revelwood, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes.

Read the obelisk in the Nomad Highlands to proceed!

Read all the above-mentioned obelisks to finish the quest!

Notes from the researcher Loraine Crim detail the location of obelisks in the Revelwood, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes.

Read the obelisk in the Kindlewastes to proceed!

Read all the above-mentioned obelisks to finish the quest!

p.n: Find All Crafting Recipes In The Hollow Halls
p.t:
You've found a hidden crafting recipe inside the Hollow Halls. 

Obtain all recipes scattered throughout the Halls in each biome to decorate your home with a new mysterious flair!

p.n: Find All Hidden Crafting Recipes In The Blackmire
p.t: You've found a hidden crafting recipe in the Blackmire! Obtain all 5 recipes scattered throughout the area to unlock traversal options for your home, as well as buffs and decorations!

You've learned that an enslaved worker planned to escape the Camellia Lake Marble Quarry.

His escape was surely apprehended. Search the area marked on your map to find the escapist!
You've found a note that mentioned a nearby Ancient Obelisk. Reach the area marked on your map to find the Obelisk!
A note you've found reveals the existence of a small secret brewing room in the Elixir Production Site. Find the room and plunder it for valuables!
A note revealed that a frustrated office worker threw a lost & found chest from his balcony. Descend there and dig up the chest!

p.n: Find The Hidden Chest In Alba
p.t:
You've found a note that described a secret chest on the roof of Gateway Outpost "Alba".

Behind the gong on the roof there should be a small room only accessible by jumping and reaching a secret door. Find the room and open the chest inside!

You've found what seems to be a piece of a treasure map while exploring the remains of a dragon skeleton! There's inconspicuous writing on the back of the parchment.

Perhaps there are more pieces like this one in similar places. If you find all of them, you can combine them into a reconstructed treasure map!

Find all of the treasure map pieces!

p.n: Combine The Treasure Map Pieces Through Crafting
p.t:
You've found the 4 treasure map pieces, but they're hard to read in their current state.

Use them to craft a reconstructed treasure map!

p.n: Find The Treasure With The Treasure Map
p.t:
You've reconstructed the treasure map, and you can make out its details now. You can see a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: 

Mae's Memoir:
The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest
The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds
As the sunlight sets in the faraway west
On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms 

Polaris' Memoir:
I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky
To find your path, you must look to me only
Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny
Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

Orpheus' Memoir:
Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss
Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains
Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss
My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

Ony's' Memoir:
I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

p.n: Solve The Riddle To Obtain The Treasure
p.t:
You've followed the map to a hidden temple behind a waterfall, but its treasure lies behind a locked door.

Lights above the door indicate that it can be opened by a mechanism. Figure out how to open the door to obtain the treasure!

quests.n: The Alchemy Of Bean And Water

p.t:
You’ve found a note about a broken coffee machine.
If they roasted and brewed coffee here, their recipes must be around somewhere.

Find the recipes, so you can recreate them on your own!

The bard assistant, Chester Loft, wrote in a note about heading to the Lord's magnificent castle.

Perhaps you can find something interesting there that can be of use to you. Reach Lord Vorgoth's throne room and search it!

You've found a dead Capybara. Its body is still warm and carries traces of vicious Drak'Dal bite marks. 

It seems that the Drak'Dal have been hunting and devouring Capybara. Such a foul deed cannot go unjudged. 

Find the nearby enemy camp and avenge the animal's death! Perhaps you can even save some of its brethren in the process.

p.n: Find The Red Marble Arch Recipe
p.t:
You've found a note that alludes to some interesting architectural features of the Hollow Hall in the Veilwater Basin.

If you reach the end of the Hollow Halls, you may discover a new crafting recipe for red marble arches.

You've found a note by Lord Vorgoth. It seems like he kept a diary while invading Cinder's Cradle. There may be more pages around.

Discover all of Lord Vorgoth's notes in Cinder's Cradle to find a reward!

You've found Lord Vorgoth's second note. The last note must be close to the Ancient capital.

Find Lord Vorgoth's final note to uncover a hidden chest!

You've discovered all of Lord Vorgoth's diary entries. You have a feeling that the final note marks treasures below.

Dig below Lord Vorgoth's third note to unearth a treasure chest!

You've read in a note that Lord Vorgoth was idling inside a tower by the Battlefield in Cinder's Cradle.

Perhaps he left something of use nearby.
Reach the tower and look around for signs of Lord Vorgoth!

You've found and rescued a farmer named Fenrig Mills. He wonders where everyone is. Before he passed, the town of Fort Kelvin was said to be a safe place for travelers. 

He suggested you search the town for any survivors, or people like him which you could bring back to life!

Fenrig the Farmer believes that life is utterly meaningless without some garden gnomes. He wasn't allowed to have any, but other farms might have had garden gnomes as decorations.

Visit one such farm and find a garden gnome!

The villager Hannah Reed is missing her daughter and hopes you can find her near the Vukah Ceremony Hill. 

Investigate the area and search for pure souls there!

p.n: Investigate The Cliffside Near Fort Kelvin
p.t:
The Vukah hold inhumane rituals at Fort Kelvin. Marianne Reed reported that the Vukah regularly push the townsfolk off the cliff, and she wants to learn more.

Investigate the sacrificial pit!

You've discovered a gruesome sacrificial pit at the foot of the cliffs by Fort Kelvin. There, you uncovered daggers and a newspaper clipping centered on the King's mishandling of the town's safety concerns.

Talk to Marianne Reed about your findings!

Fenrig the Farmer explained that villagers need food and a warm, sheltered bed to do their best work and be happy. You can assign a spare bed to your followers by using the summoning staff and aiming it at a bed.

Assign a sheltered bed to Fenrig to proceed!

p.n: Visit Anton Godwin's Last Known Location
p.t:
Oscar Godwin is missing his cousin, Anton Godwin. Travel to the prison where he's held,  Gateway Outpost "Drifa", and search it!

Find Oscar's cousin and return him to his family!
You've reached the prison that Anton Godwin was held in. Search the prison for any traces of Anton and rescue his soul to please his cousin, Oscar!

The villager Robert Gibson misses his fiancée, Kaori. She was last seen in East Lapis, awaiting a bundle of clothes and fabrics she planned to ship.

Investigate the Weaver's Cottage in East Lapis to search for clues!
You've discovered a note at the Weaver's Cottage that mentioned that Kaori Conway has an office in East Lapis. Search the area marked on your map to investigate her office!

p.n: Find The Cursed Fisher In Pondsworth
p.t:
A townsfolk told you about the inventory of a strange fisher in Pondsworth. He always sold both trash and treasures, but rarely fish. Perhaps there is something strange about this fisherman that requires an investigation.

Reach Pondsworth and look for clues there!

You found a note that mentioned a cursed fishing rod, which was stored by the fisher in a Pondsworth basement.

Find a way to access the underground and retrieve the fishing rod!
You've read a note that referred to a nearby hunting party from the Kindlewastes! Look for remnants of the hunting party to search for its members!

p.n: Reach And Loot The Draconian Vulture Nest
p.t: There's special loot to be found at a Draconian Vulture nest in the Kindlewastes. Search the area and grab what you can!

p.n: Climb The Ancient Spire In The Kindlewastes
p.t:
The Hunter Assistant, Galen Yager, wants you to find and scale the Ancient Spire in the Kindelwastes.

Doing so will unlock points of interest on your map.

The Alchemist Assistant Paulette wants to greet all sorts of spirits during Hollow's Eve by adding carved pumpkins to your base! You should find some pumpkin farms in the Albaneve Summits to learn how to make them!

c.t: Pick up Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I

p.t: There are more pumpkin farms around. Visit the next location to retrieve a medium-sized carved pumpkin!

c.t: Pick up Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I

p.t: There are more pumpkin farms around. Visit the next location to retrieve a large carved pumpkin!

c.t: Pick up Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
Pick up Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I

p.n: Build A Sheltered Bed For Elio
p.t: The Barber needs a proper place to sleep. Build him a sheltered bed to progress!

The Barber Elio needs to soothe his coffee addiction and has asked you for help.

He's instructed you to retrieve a machine for roasting coffee beans and suspects that such a thing could be found in Stillwater Bay, a town with a large harbor and nearby coffee plantations.

Reach Stillwater Bay to begin your search!

You've reached Stillwater Bay. There must be suitable coffee-making equipment here.

Look around to find an appropriate coffee-making tool!

p.n: Search For A Plushy In Pikemead's Reach
p.t:
The Farmer Emily seems to be scared of Fell Critter. Her friend, your Barber Elio, wants to alleviate her fears! 

He thinks that these creatures may not be so scary if represented as fluffy cuddlebuddies, and mentioned that he often saw children play with toys like that in the capital. 

Reach the main city and search for a plushy there to show it to Emily!

You've found a plushy of a Fell Critter.

Now talk to the Farmer, Emily, to alleviate her fears!

p.n: Find Out How To Assemble A Telescope
p.t:
The Barber wants to gaze longingly at the stars. For this, he would like a telescope and has instructed you to figure out how to make one.

There may be more information about telescopes somewhere in Cinder's Cradle. Finding an observatory will be a good start.

You've found a note that details the individual parts of a telescope. This has enabled you to craft the item yourself!

The Barber should be pleased. Talk to the Barber to let him know about your findings!

quests.n: Activating The Gate To The Stars

p.n: Reach And Use The First Dungeon Entrance
p.t:
The Ancient Researcher, Loraine Crim, told you that there's a platform at Cinder's Ascent which serves as a teleporter to the floating isles above.

However, to power the teleporter, you must first light the beacons around it. Each beacon is connected to one biosphere.

Loraine wants you to light the beacon of the Springlands first. The beacon will be inside a dungeon. The entrance to this dungeon is marked on your map.

Reach the entrance to the Springlands dungeon to proceed.

You've entered the Springlands beacon dungeon. It seems to resemble a museum. 

Loraine Crim, the researcher, believes that there must be a beacon somewhere around here. If you want to power the teleportation platform at Cinder's Ascent, you will have to find this beacon — and many more.

 Reach the end of the museum to start routing energy to the ancient platform!

You've activated one of the six necessary beacons. Many more must follow.

Complete all remaining beacon dungeons to power the teleport platform at Cinder's Ascent. Their entrances are marked on your map and can all be found within Cinder's Cradle.

You are free to complete the dungeons in whichever order you like.
Complete all dungeons to light the beacons and to ascend to the floating isles above.

You've lit every beacon in each biosphere. The Ancient Researcher will be pleased.

Talk to Loraine Crim to proceed! She will have more information on where to head next.

p.n: Use The Teleport Platform At Cinder's Ascent
p.t:
You've activated the teleport platform at Cinder's Ascent. The researcher, Loraine, wants you to use it to reach the Ancient islands above. 

She thinks the Mother Flame, situated in the Ancient Capital high above, is under threat. The Ancients and the Flame are in dire need of aid.

Use the teleport platform to reach the floating islands.

You've reached the floating isles of Cinder's Cradle. Your suspicions are proven true: The islands are already under attack by the Shroud.

The Shroud is attacking what is left of the Ancients and creeping towards the Mother Flame, threatening to destroy order as we know it.

You have to reach the Ancient capital above to stop this madness before it is too late!

You've reached the citadel, home of the Mother Flame and last haven of the Ancients.

The Shroud is already laying siege to the capital, headed by Lord Vorgoth. He aims to destroy the Mother Flame and to seal the fate of all Ancients in perpetuity. This will bring forth a new era and a new balance of power. You have to stop him.

Defeat Lord Vorgoth before he can drain the Mother Flame.

Vorgoth may be gone, but the Shroud is still gnawing at the Mother Flame. Her light is weak, and the Ancients trapped inside are under threat of fading forever.

Go to the Mother Flame and keep her fire burning, no matter the cost.

The Ancient Researcher wants to craft an Infusion Altar to create archaic infusions. The infusions will be very helpful when it comes to crafting Ancient gear and decor.

Craft and Infusion Altar to proceed.

The Infusion Altar is ready to be placed. 

Place it in your base to proceed!

quests.n: A Gem Forge Of Our Own

p.n: Find A Gem Forge Crafting Recipe
p.t:
The Researcher, Loraine, believes that you may be able to find the crafting recipe for a highly advanced gem forge. She thinks you should start your search in the citadel, the capital of the Ancients.

With the recipe, you will be able to craft and place your very own gem forge.

Find a gem forge recipe in the citadel.
